title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on.
  
  
dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights.
  
  
Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Staff Full-Stack Engineer on the Cloud Clients team, you’ll own end-to-end delivery across the surfaces where dbt developers do their work:
**dbt Studio in the browser, the dbt VS Code extension, and the CLI workspace runtime that powers both**
.
  
  
You’ll help build dbt’s
**AI-native developer experience**
, including agent workflows, diff review, streaming tool calls, charts and rich outputs for conversational analytics, and MCP apps that bring dbt projects directly into tools like Claude and Codex. This is a true full-stack role: you’ll work across
**Python, TypeScript, React, and Kubernetes**
, with the expectation that you can take a feature from schema and service design through to the final pixel without a handoff
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own parts of the CLI workspace runtime that backs both surfaces, including migrating users off our legacy IDE and enabling asynchronous, background agent runs.
* Design and build agent-facing experiences: streaming responses, transparent tool calls, diff review, and charting / rich output for conversational analytics.
* Extend dbt into other developer surfaces — MCP integrations that make dbt projects usable directly from AI clients like Claude and Codex.
* Lead well-scoped projects end to end: write the plan, partner with design and product, ship in two-week increments, and measure whether it worked.
* Share oncall and customer support for your surfaces, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers.

Skills we are looking for
  
  

* 8+ years building production software, including senior-level ownership of projects that ran for months and involved several people.
* Deep Python experience plus exposure to TypeScript and React experience — you move across the stack without waiting for a handoff.
* Built and maintained something other developers depend on: an IDE, an editor extension, a CLI, an SDK, an LSP server, or a data tool.
* Comfort with the operational side of shipping — APIs, Kubernetes, Postgres, observability — and with being on the hook when something breaks.
* Strong written communication: you can make a technical argument in a document and bring people along.
* Worked asynchronously as part of a fully-remote, distributed team

Bonus points for
  
  

* Shipped LLM- or agent-powered features to production, with real opinions on evaluation, latency, cost, and where models fall down.
* Worked with the Language Server Protocol, Monaco, CodeMirror, or other code-editor internals.
* Hands-on dbt, SQL, or data warehouse experience (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).
* Migrated users off a legacy product surface and decommissioned it without breaking them.
* Go, Rust, or systems-level performance experience.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
- RSU stock grants\*
- Professional development and training opportunities
- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
- Monthly cell phone stipend
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
  
  
*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
TITLE
  
  
Senior Full-Stack Developer
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We build and run a multi-tenant risk-management platform for commercial insurance. Underwriters and loss-control consultants use it to survey sites, raise recommendations, and track whether anyone actually did anything about them. It is a real product with real customers and about fifteen years of history. The work is roughly half building new things and half making old things behave.
  
  
This engineer will own features end to end. Angular in the browser, .NET on the server, SQL Server and MongoDB underneath, deployed through our own pipeline to customer sandboxes. This is not full stack used as a polite word for front-end work with occasional API calls. They will write the query, the endpoint, the component and the test.
  
  
As a Senior Analyst in Full Stack Engineering, you’ll own features end to end across the browser, server, data layers, and tests. You’ll design, develop, enhance, test, troubleshoot, and support software solutions; contribute to technical design decisions; and collaborate with engineering and business partners.
  
  
You’ll work with Angular 16, TypeScript, RxJS, Kendo UI for Angular, Angular Material, Bootstrap, and SignalR. The back end includes C# and .NET services, SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, xUnit, and Moq. The platform includes a classic ASP.NET Website alongside the modern Angular application. Our delivery environment includes Kubernetes through Rancher Desktop, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and yuniql database migrations.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain full stack software components across front-end, back-end, integration, and data layers in alignment with Duck Creek engineering standards.
* Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to determine appropriate software design approaches, implementation options, and solution impacts.
* Build and maintain scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable application features using established software development methodologies, coding standards, and architecture patterns.
* Contribute to technical design activities, including application flow, component interaction, API design, data structures, integration points, and system behavior.
* Develop and support front-end application functionality, including user interface components, client-side logic, usability considerations, and integration with services or APIs.
* Develop and support back-end application functionality, including business logic, service layers, APIs, data access, system integrations, and application performance considerations.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects, production issues, configuration problems, and technical anomalies using structured analytical and problem-solving techniques.
* Perform code reviews, unit testing, integration testing support, debugging, and technical validation to ensure solution quality, maintainability, and adherence to standards.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, business analysts, quality engineers, DevOps engineers, and other technical stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess risks, and deliver effective solutions.
* Adapt existing approaches, frameworks, and technical patterns to address non-routine problems where information may be limited, incomplete, or subject to interpretation.
* Support continuous improvement of engineering practices, including automation, reusable components, development processes, documentation, code quality, and technical knowledge sharing.
* Advise peers and cross-functional partners on technical matters within the full stack engineering discipline, including solution behavior, implementation considerations, and issue resolution approaches.
* Front end Angular 16 with Kendo UI for Angular, Angular Material and Bootstrap. State is a hand-rolled Behavior Subject store rather than NgRx, which was a deliberate choice and is occasionally annoying. Lazy-loaded feature modules behind a module registry. SignalR for live updates. Four locales.
* There are two front ends. The modern Angular application, and a classic ASP.NET Website that predates it, which has no project file and is still load-bearing. They are bridged by Angular components compiled to custom elements and embedded into the older pages. It is a managed mess, and whoever joins will spend time there.

Back end
  
  
A .NET 10 service in clean architecture, tested with xUnit and Moq. MongoDB holds configuration documents and SQL Server carries the query workload. Multi-tenancy is enforced on every request from a JWT claim, so one customer seeing another customer's data is the failure mode we design against. There is also a .NET Core 3.1 service not yet retired, Kafka between several workers, and a newer .NET 10 microservice handling large file uploads.
  
  
Infrastructure
  
  
Kubernetes locally through Rancher Desktop. Jenkins for CI/CD. Azure DevOps for work items and source. Static analysis, dependency scanning, secret detection and DAST in the pipeline. Database migrations through yuniql across per-tenant databases.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Days one to three. Local environment running and a small fix shipped end to end to a sandbox. Our setup is documented in enough detail that an agent can work through most of it.
  
  
Through the first release. Defects, and only defects. This is deliberate. Working through real bugs across the whole system is how someone learns where the two front ends meet, where multi-tenancy is enforced, and how our review process behaves under pressure.
  
  
Month two or three. Ownership of something substantial. A slice of the Angular and Kendo upgrade, or a feature in the dashboard service. By this point they should be the person others ask about some part of the system.
  
  
**What You’ve Done**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline; or equivalent combination of education, training, and additional relevant experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of applicable professional experience in software development, full stack engineering, application development, systems integration, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Experience developing and maintaining software applications using front-end and back-end technologies in a professional software engineering environment.
* Experience analyzing requirements, designing technical solutions, writing production-quality code, troubleshooting issues, and participating in software delivery activities.
* Experience working independently on assignments that require evaluation of identifiable factors, technical judgment, and adaptation of existing approaches.
* Several years building and shipping web applications, owning both sides of the API boundary.
* Angular 12 or later, TypeScript, RxJS.
* C# and .NET, anywhere from Core 3.1 through .NET 8.
* SQL Server written by hand as well as through an ORM. Able to read a query plan and have an opinion about it.
* Demonstrable Claude Code experience on real work, not experiments.
* Able to work US Eastern hours on an ongoing basis.
* Comfortable working in code that is ten to fifteen years old without either rewriting it or being frightened of it.
* Has influenced how systems were built, not only implemented someone else's design.
* React or Vue instead of Angular. Java or Node instead of .NET. PostgreSQL or Oracle instead of SQL Server. Someone strong in a neighbouring stack is a better hire for us than someone weak in ours.

**Preferred**

* Kendo UI for Angular.
* MongoDB, Kafka or another message broker, SignalR or WebSockets.
* Azure, Kubernetes, Jenkins or comparable CI/CD.
* Multi-tenant systems of any kind.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join Revun as a Full-Stack Developer to scale web applications using cutting-edge technology. Build robust API integrations and enhance coding with AI tools, working in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**About Revun**
Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Full-Stack Developer at Revun, you'll be at the forefront of scaling our web applications. Your day-to-day tasks include reviewing sprint tasks, refactoring backend logic in Laravel, and designing responsive frontends using Tailwind CSS. You will engage with third-party API integration and leverage AI coding assistants to enhance your workflows.
  
  
Working closely with the Lead Developer and reporting to the Technical Lead/Founder, your responsibilities include delivering clean, modular code, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, and accelerating development velocity through AI tools. Your success will be assessed by your ability to meet sprint deadlines and ship functional code features consistently.
  
  
Within the first 90 days, you'll focus on successfully integrating APIs and leveraging AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining strong code standards. A successful candidate is resourceful, embraces modern coding tools, and communicates progress effectively.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Deliver clean, modular, and scalable code using Laravel and Tailwind CSS or any other modern frontend framework to enhance web application performance and client project outcomes.
* Review sprint tasks, manage pull requests, and refactor backend logic in collaboration with the team, ensuring consistency and quality.
* Write and refactor both backend logic in Laravel and design responsive frontend layouts using Tailwind CSS and Blade components.
* Test and debug third-party API connections, handle complex payloads, and manage error logs effectively.
* Leverage AI coding assistants to draft boilerplate structures, write unit tests, and iterate on feature implementation rapidly.
* Complete assigned feature sprints, conduct code reviews, and test API endpoints to ensure stability and performance.
* Optimize database queries, perform security audits of input validations, and update documentation for integrated modules to maintain system integrity.
* Successfully integrate APIs and leverage AI tools within the first 90 days to accelerate development velocity while maintaining rigorous code standards.
* Troubleshoot unforeseen API documentation errors and resolve merge conflicts or unexpected breaking changes efficiently.

What we are looking for
  
  

* At least 4 years of hands-on experience in web development with SaaS or client applications.
* In-depth experience with PHP and the Laravel framework for building robust applications.
* Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or any similar JavaScript framework.
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho.
* Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows.
* Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience in software development within the IT sector.
* Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

What we offer
  
  
CAD $18,000 to $30,000 per year.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Remote work flexibility
* Professional development opportunities

Schedule
  
  
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST Timezone).
  
  
What happens next
  
  
Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.
  
  
If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.
  
  
Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.
  
  
Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.
  
  
Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.
  
  
We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).
  
  
**About Diagrid**
At Diagrid, we're building the infrastructure that helps developers build, deploy, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable applications.
  
  
Built on the foundation of Dapr, the CNCF-graduated open-source project, Diagrid is helping engineering teams simplify the complexity of distributed systems. As AI transforms how software is built and operated, we're extending that mission to help developers take AI agents from experimentation to production with confidence.
  
  
We're a globally distributed team of engineers and builders who care deeply about solving complex technical problems, contributing to open source, and creating products developers love.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a talented
**Fullstack Engineer with strong Node.js and TypeScript experience**
to join our growing AI & DevEx team, led by Casper Nielsen.
  
  
You'll help build the next generation of Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer tools, working across backend services, APIs, and user-facing applications.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building products end-to-end, solving complex technical challenges, and working in a fast-moving startup environment.
  
  
You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to turn ideas into production-ready capabilities, with a focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build end-to-end product features: Design, develop, and maintain fullstack applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks.
* Develop scalable backend services: Build APIs, integrations, and services that power Diagrid's AI infrastructure and developer-facing products.
* Work on AI infrastructure: Help develop the tools and services that enable developers to build, deploy, manage, and operate AI agents reliably in production.
* Own features from concept to production: Participate in technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.
* Create great developer experiences: Build intuitive interfaces, APIs, and workflows that make complex distributed systems easier to use.
* Collaborate across teams: Work closely with AI, platform, product, and engineering teams to solve technical challenges and deliver customer value.
* Champion engineering quality: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to architectural decisions, and continuously improve engineering practices.
* Solve challenging technical problems: Work on distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, integrations, and the reliability challenges that come with production AI applications.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Strong professional experience developing production applications with TypeScript and Node.js.
* Experience building modern web applications using React or a similar frontend framework.
* Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and service integrations.
* Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud-native development, containerization, and modern deployment practices.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Ability to independently own technical projects and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in an environment where requirements evolve.
* Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams.
* A product mindset and genuine interest in understanding the problems developers and customers are trying to solve.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered applications, AI agents, or LLM integrations.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks, orchestration tools, or agent development patterns.
* Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or microservices.
* Knowledge of Dapr, Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with real-time systems, messaging, or asynchronous workflows.
* Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with developer-focused products.
* Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth technology startup.

**Working Hours**
**Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.**
**Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.**
What Makes This Opportunity Exciting
  
  
**Build at the intersection of AI and distributed systems.**
Work on real engineering challenges involved in making AI agents reliable, secure, and production-ready.
  
  
**Make a meaningful impact.**
Join a growing engineering team where your ideas, technical decisions, and contributions directly influence the products we build.
  
  
**Own what you build.**
Take responsibility for features end-to-end, from initial design through production and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Work with experienced engineers.**
Collaborate with a globally distributed team building infrastructure for the next generation of software.
  
  
**Help shape what's next.**
Be part of an ambitious company working at the forefront of cloud-native and AI application development.
  
  
**Diagrid Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Company equity
* Remote first & flexible work environment
* Flexible paid time off
* Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents
* Choice of hardware
* $1000 for home office setup
* Monthly WFH stipend
* Team events & gatherings
* Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

Diagrid, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Software Development
  
  
Join Royal York Property Management as a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the architecture and maintenance of our key web portals and client applications. Work with cutting-edge AI tools in a remote, dynamic environment.
  
  
**About Royal York Property Management**
At Royal York Property Management, we take pride in managing our clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care as we would our own. Our approach to property management is meticulous, whether it involves addressing maintenance emergencies or conducting tenant showings. In every task, we consider whether the standards we apply are equivalent to those we would expect for our properties. Prioritizing the needs of our clients and tenants is at the forefront of our mission, ensuring we deliver exceptional service every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Royal York Property Management, you will be responsible for architecting, scaling, and maintaining our core web platforms. You will play a vital role in managing complex backend ecosystems using Laravel and dynamic frontends with Vue.js, ensuring seamless integration with third-party APIs like Google Ads and Zoho. Your expertise will guide the development of secure, scalable, and fast-delivery features using AI-assisted coding workflows.
  
  
In your day-to-day, you'll write clean and maintainable backend code, develop reactive UI components, and manage API endpoints and webhooks. You will leverage AI tools to enhance development speed and maintain a robust architectural structure across projects. You will work closely with our technical leads, operating with high autonomy to design and execute high-level project requirements into functional systems.
  
  
Success in this role means delivering modular, scalable features rapidly, achieving zero critical downtime, and ensuring robust security implementations. You'll excel if you take a proactive approach to security, love clean architecture, and possess a flair for integrating AI workflows into traditional coding practices.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Architect and maintain core web portals and client applications using Laravel and Vue.js.
* Write clean, maintainable backend business logic in Laravel and develop reactive UI components in Vue.js.
* Design, test, and monitor external API endpoints, handle incoming and outgoing webhook payloads, and trace debug logs.
* Utilize AI coding assistants to rapidly prototype and refactor code, and write comprehensive test suites.
* Review code architecture, optimize database queries, and ensure security compliance across active projects.
* Deliver major feature sprints, verify webhook reliability, and perform code reviews.
* Conduct security audits, optimize API rate-usage tracking, and update technical documentation.
* Architect new multi-tenant modules, refactor legacy architecture, and troubleshoot complex production scaling bottlenecks.
* Achieve zero critical downtime in production and implement clean API error handling and robust security measures.
* Build and document robust, fault-tolerant API integrations with error recovery and rate-limit handling.
* Deliver scalable, secure, and modular features rapidly using modern AI-assisted development workflows.
* Difficulties arise when handling asynchronous event/APIs, ignoring security fundamentals, or relying on outdated development methods.
* Debug broken or delayed webhook payloads, manage API quota suspensions, and resolve security vulnerabilities under tight deadlines.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on software development experience building production-grade web applications.
* Deep expertise in PHP and Laravel for backend development. Proficiency in frontend development with a strong grasp of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS and Vue.js.
* Extensive experience in REST APIs, OAuth protocols, and Webhooks. Knowledge of various third-party platforms like Payment Gateways, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Zoho for integrations.
* Strong knowledge of comprehensive web security best practices, including CSRF, XSS protection, secure authentication methods, data encryption, and safe payload validation.
* Proficiency in Git for version control, and experience with deployment on cloud platforms such as AWS and Cloudways.
* Familiarity with SSH and command-line tools for efficient server management and deployment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* English — fluent, spoken and written.

Nice to have
  
  

* Python proficiency is an advantage, especially for potential integration or data-driven tasks.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools to enhance coding speed and quality is preferred.

What we offer
  
  
CAD $24,000 to $40,000 per year.
  
  
Schedule
  
  
Full-Time, Mon-Fri, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
  
  
What happens next
  
  
Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.
  
  
If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.
  
  
Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
description:
A different kind of organization
  
  

* High trust, transparency, and autonomy
* Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
* Radical compensation transparency
* Sense of ownership in collective success
* Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role
  
  
As a Lead/Principal Engineer, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.
  
  
What the work looks like
  
  
We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:
  
  

* Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
* Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
* Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
* Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Frame Problems & Propose Solutions
  
  

* Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
* Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
* Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence
  
  

* Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
* Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
* Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
* Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
* Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains
  
  
Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.
  
  
You'll thrive here if
  
  

* You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
* You think in systems, not isolated parts.
* You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
* You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
* You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
* You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for
  
  

* 14+ years building software systems in complex environments.
* Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
* Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
* Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote India)
description:
**Help build the open future of digital intelligence**
At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights.
  
  
Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data.
  
  
Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You’ll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you’ll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use.
  
  
Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains:
**Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform**
. You’ll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap.
  
  
You’ll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it.]
  
  
Your work will directly influence:
  
  

* The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions.
* How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them.
* How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo.
* How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale.

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like.
* Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first.
* Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems.
* Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery.
* Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them.
* Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions.
* Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it.
* Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket.
* Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites.
* The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility.
* Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment
* A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

**Helpful experience**

* You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback.
* Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems.
* Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business.
* Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments.
* Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software.

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact.
  
  
**Why Matomo?**
Matomo is for people who want their work to matter.
  
  
You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms.
  
  
We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next.
  
  
We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it.
  
  
High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution.
  
  
You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes.
  
  
We also protect focused work through:
  
  

* No-meeting Fridays
* No more than two days each week with late meetings
* No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant.
  
  
**Benefits**

* 100% remote working within your country of employment
* Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role
* 25 days of paid annual leave
* Home-office equipment allowance
* Health insurance support, where applicable
* Mental-health and wellbeing support
* Paid volunteering day
* Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment.
  
  
**Hiring Process**
Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)
  
  
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
Matomo values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products.
  
  
**Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere.**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.
  
  
**Title:**
Software Engineer II, Full-Stack Engineer
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Ship user-facing features end to end — schema and endpoint through to the screen, the empty state, the loading state, and the error someone will actually hit.
* Turn a loosely worded request into a written spec precise enough that an agent, or a new teammate, can build from it without guessing.
* Review hard. Your own pull requests, your teammates', and the ones an agent opened. Catching a plausible-looking mistake before it merges is the highest-value hour of your week.
* Write tests that would genuinely fail if the feature broke, and verify the change in the running product rather than trusting a green checkmark.
* Work inside conventions the repository already encodes — house rules, lint rules, coverage thresholds, component patterns — and improve those conventions when they turn out to be wrong.
* Roll changes out behind feature flags and watch what monitoring says afterwards.
* Pick up whatever is in front of the team. Priorities here move; a bug in a service you have never opened is still yours if it is the most useful thing to fix.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years building and shipping production web software that real users depended on.
* Strong TypeScript. You use types to catch mistakes before they reach production, not just to keep the compiler quiet. You can work out what an unfamiliar type is describing, write one that matches the real shape of your data, and recognise when a simpler type would do the same job.
* Real React depth. Component composition, where state should live, why something re-rendered, and how to test a component the way a user meets it.
* Enough server-side experience to be useful on day one in NestJS or a comparable framework: dependency injection, request validation, REST design, and talking to a database, a cache and a queue.
* You have worked in a large shared codebase and can find your way around unfamiliar code without waiting for a tour.
* You have used AI coding agents on real work and have opinions about where they fail.
* Clear written English. Specifications, pull request descriptions, review comments. In this workflow, writing is load-bearing rather than a soft skill.
* Comfortable being told the priority changed — and able to put down something half-finished cleanly.

**Nice to have**

* Nx, Turborepo or another monorepo toolchain.
* Data-dense interfaces: virtualised or enterprise data grids, charting, filter builders.
* GCP, Kafka, BullMQ, Prisma, MongoDB, Redis.
* Feature flags and production observability (LaunchDarkly, Datadog, or equivalents).
* Go-to-market, sales technology or B2B data as a domain.

**About Us**
ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.
  
  
ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information.
  
  
ZoomInfo may use a software-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here.
  
  
ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
**Description**
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
  
  
Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
  
  
This role at Enphase requires working onsite 3 days a week, with plans to transition back to a full 5 day in office schedule over time.
  
  
About the role:
  
  
Enphase is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5–8 years of experience building enterprise applications using Java and Angular. In this role, you will design, build, and own web applications and APIs that support Enphase's business operations, including finance and supply chain, and contribute enhancements and fixes to our mobile applications. You will contribute to design discussions and mentor junior developers while working in an AI-first engineering model, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to accelerate development, analysis, testing, and bug fixing, and owning the quality, security, and maintainability of everything you ship. As a member of the IT team, you will work closely with business users, product owners, and engineers across multiple teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack web applications using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions for enterprise-grade solutions and own the technical design of the modules you deliver
* Build microservices and RESTful APIs documented with OpenAPI/Swagger, with clean contracts, versioning, and robust error handling
* Develop responsive, accessible, and performant Angular UIs using TypeScript, RxJS, and reusable components, with a strong focus on user experience
* Implement enhancements and fixes to mobile applications (Android/iOS, native or hybrid) and coordinate releases with QA and the mobile team
* Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of daily work to accelerate code generation, refactoring, unit test creation, and documentation
* Leverage AI tools to analyze logs, stack traces, and unfamiliar codebases to speed up root cause analysis and bug fixing
* Apply AI-assisted analysis to requirements, data, and production issues to shorten the path from problem to solution
* Critically review, validate, and test AI-generated code for correctness, security, and performance before it is merged
* Share prompts, reusable workflows, and practices that help the team get more out of AI-assisted engineering
* Design data models and write efficient queries across relational (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems such as ERP and with third-party services via REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, and middleware
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma, Cypress/Playwright) and maintain strong code coverage
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerize services with Docker and Kubernetes, and deploy to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Ensure application performance, scalability, and security, following OWASP practices and OAuth 2.0/SSO standards
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and help raise the team's engineering standards
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment, providing estimates and coordinating dependencies across multiple teams
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, API specifications, and runbooks
* Adhere to SDLC and change management processes, including controls required in a SOX-regulated environment

**Who You Are And What You Bring**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or higher, with a minimum of 70% marks (or equivalent CGPA) consistently throughout academics — 10th, 12th, and Graduation/Post-Graduation
* Must have graduated from an institution featured in the Top 100 NIRF (National Institutional Ranking Framework) rankings at the time of graduation (Overall / Engineering category)
* 5–8 years of full stack software development experience, including 4+ years with Angular
* Front End: Angular (12+ preferred), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, RxJS
* Back End: Java (11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, Microservices
* APIs: RESTful services, OpenAPI/Swagger
* Databases: SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB)
* Mobile: exposure to native (Kotlin/Swift) or cross-platform (Ionic, React Native, Flutter) development and app store release processes
* AI-Assisted Development: demonstrated, practical use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate development, analysis, and debugging, with real examples you can walk us through
* Ability to give AI tools clear context and instructions, and the engineering judgment to recognize when AI output is wrong
* DevOps: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes
* Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Servers: Tomcat, GlassFish
* Version Control and Methodologies: Git, Agile/Scrum
* Certifications in Java, Angular, or cloud platforms are a plus
* Exposure to integrating with enterprise applications such as ERP or CRM systems is a plus

Non-Technical Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage finance and business users in their language
* Experience owning a feature or workstream end to end, mentoring junior developers, and working directly with stakeholders
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a professional, diligent, and hardworking attitude
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with aggressive timelines and multiple teams coordinating with each other
* Proven ability to work independently and manage competing priorities

title: .Net Fullstack Developer - Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
Do you have a strong software engineering background, a passion for problem-solving, and want to join one of the largest tech companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you!
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior Software Engineer**
who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By merging data, cloud, AI and design with deep industry expertise, we create impactful yet intuitive digital solutions that empower people and move businesses forward.
  
  
As part of our engineering team, you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-quality software solutions. You will work across the full stack and play a key role in delivering quality software, solving complex technical challenges, and driving engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Senior Software Engineer**

* You join a skilled team of software engineers and technology professionals where you learn new things together with your colleagues.
* You design, develop, and maintain robust backend services and APIs using .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, and Java.
* You build and enhance front-end features using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar technologies.
* You develop and maintain automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright with Cucumber.
* You practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) by writing unit and integration tests before or alongside feature development.
* You collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, QA Engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
* You participate in code reviews and help enforce coding standards, security best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles.
* You troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* You analyze, optimize, and tune database queries for performance, scalability, and efficiency.
* You contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and support DevOps practices.
* You document technical designs and actively participate in architecture discussions.
* You contribute to building scalable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* You have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* You have strong proficiency in .NET and C#, with hands-on experience building web applications and APIs using ASP.NET Core, including Web API, MVC, and Entity Framework.
* You have solid experience with Java, preferably using Spring Boot or an equivalent enterprise framework.
* You have hands-on experience with JavaScript and TypeScript for front-end or full-stack development.
* You have hands-on experience developing BDD-style automated test suites using Playwright with Cucumber.
* You have a strong commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience driving feature development through unit, integration, and acceptance tests.
* You have experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture.
* You have experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* You have demonstrated experience optimizing SQL queries, indexes, and execution plans for high-performance applications.
* You are proficient in version control systems, particularly Git.
* You have a strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean code practices.
* You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end-to-end development process, you will continue to both learn from, and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.
  
  
**We also believe you have**

* Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably GCP.
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Kafka.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Redis.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted SDLC practices and experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot or BMAD to support development, code review, test generation, and documentation.
* A proactive mindset and an interest in continuously improving software engineering practices and technical solutions.

**We offer**
We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.
  
  
**Did we get you inspired?**
We look forward to your application!
  
  
Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
  
  
Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

title: Senior Full Stack Developer – Generative AI
description:
About Us

Walnut Folks Group is the parent company of three agencies shaping how brands grow in India:

- Confluencr – influencer marketing (700+ brands served)

- Intent Farm – performance and marketplace marketing

- Kalakaaar – talent representation

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer – Generative AI who can take a problem from idea to production.

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive technical specifications and implement tickets. You'll work closely with founders, business teams, and product stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape solutions, build applications, and own them after launch.

You'll work across our SaaS products, Creator App, and internal AI-powered systems. Depending on the problem, you might build a customer-facing feature, develop an AI-powered workflow, or turn a manual business process into a scalable application.

We value engineers who combine solid software fundamentals with practical AI expertise, move quickly without compromising reliability, and take responsibility for the outcomes of what they build.

What You'll Do

1. Own Products End to End

Understand business problems by working directly with founders, marketing teams, operations, finance, and other stakeholders.

Translate requirements into clear technical plans, define MVPs, and prioritize features based on business impact.

Build and ship complete features across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI integrations.

Take ownership of applications throughout their lifecycle, from initial prototype to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

2. Build AI-Powered Products

Integrate LLMs and generative AI capabilities into real-world products and business workflows.

Build AI-powered features using techniques such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows where appropriate.

Evaluate models, prompts, and architectures to balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

Design workflows that combine AI with business rules, databases, and external APIs.

Implement appropriate validation, error handling, observability, and human review for AI outputs.

3. Develop Scalable Full-Stack Applications

Build responsive, user-friendly frontend experiences and reliable backend services.

Design APIs, data models, and database schemas that support product requirements and future growth.

Write maintainable, testable code and follow sound engineering practices.

Integrate third-party services, authentication systems, background jobs, and other infrastructure as needed.

Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and production issues.

4. Ship, Measure, and Improve

Prototype promising ideas quickly and validate them with actual users.

Deploy applications and manage releases, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

Use user feedback, product usage, and business outcomes to guide improvements.

Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability.

Document key technical decisions and share learnings with the team.

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills

* 2–4 years of experience building and shipping full-stack software applications.
* Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications.
* Practical experience integrating LLMs or generative AI into applications, workflows, or developer tooling.
* Experience designing and working with REST APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.
* Familiarity with deploying applications to production and troubleshooting real-world issues.
* Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into practical, well-scoped solutions.
* A strong sense of ownership, with a focus on usability, reliability, and business outcomes.
* We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone beyond basic chatbot implementations.
* Working with LLM APIs and structured model outputs.
* Building RAG pipelines, semantic search, or document-processing workflows.
* Implementing AI agents, tool calling, or multi-step AI workflows where appropriate.
* Evaluating AI output quality and handling hallucinations, failures, and edge cases.
* Using AI coding assistants to improve development speed and productivity.
* Experience building consumer-facing applications or SaaS products with active users.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and application monitoring.
* Experience with background processing, queues, caching, or event-driven systems.
* Experience in marketing technology, creator platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
* A strong portfolio, GitHub repository, live product, or technical case study demonstrating your work.
* You don't need experience with every technique listed. We value practical implementation experience and sound technical judgment over familiarity with buzzwords.

How You Work Matters

* You can communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* You are comfortable making decisions when requirements are incomplete.
* You know when to use AI, when traditional software is more reliable, and when a simpler solution is better.
* You can move fast, accept feedback, and iterate without losing sight of code quality.
* You take responsibility for what happens after deployment, not just for writing the code.

Our Technology Environment

We care more about your ability to choose the right tools and build reliable products than about matching every item on a checklist.

Depending on the product, our engineering environment may involve modern frontend frameworks, backend services, relational or NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, LLM APIs, and AI development tools.

You'll have the opportunity to evaluate technologies, experiment with new approaches, and make informed architectural decisions.

How We'll Measure Success

In this role, success means:

* Turning business problems into working solutions that users can actually use.
* Shipping useful prototypes and production features with appropriate speed and quality.
* Building AI capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, productivity, or user experience.
* Maintaining reliable applications through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Why Work With Us

Flexible Work Culture

We focus on outcomes, not rigid rules. You’ll have the autonomy to manage your work, with a culture built on trust and accountability.

Health & Accident Insurance

Your wellbeing matters to us. We provide comprehensive health and accident coverage to support you when it counts.

Complimentary Meals

Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are on us-so you can stay focused and energized throughout the day.

Sports & Outdoor Activities

From cricket matches to badminton games and monthly hikes, we keep things active with at least two sports events every month.

Upskill with Us

Get access to learning platforms like Udemy and mentorship to continuously build your marketing and growth skillset.

Performance Gets Rewarded

We recognize and reward great work through regular incentives, quarterly and annual awards, and ongoing appreciation.

Working Days: Monday to Friday (Onsite) + Saturday Half Day (WFH)

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Cloud and AI)
description:
**About GenAirate**

GenAirate builds SnapLine, a submission intelligence platform that converts unstructured broker submissions (emails, PDFs, Excel, images) into structured, decision-ready data for underwriters. SnapLine was built for Lloyd’s and the London Market and is now expanding into US specialty insurance. We are SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified.

**The role**

You will build and run the product end to end: the interfaces underwriters use, the services behind them, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. A large part of the work is the document processing pipeline that turns messy, inconsistent submissions into reliable structured data. We are looking for someone who cares about how systems are designed, takes responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks, and does not need to be chased.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build and ship full-stack features, from API and data model through to a UI that works for underwriters under time pressure
* Build and improve document processing pipelines: ingestion, classification, OCR and parsing, extraction, validation and traceability back to the source document
* Design architectures that are clean, efficient and cost-aware, and that hold up as submission volumes and document variety grow
* Build event-driven services on AWS and GCP, with sound choices on queues, storage, concurrency and failure handling
* Integrate LLM-based components (RAG, retrieval, agentic workflows) with proper evaluation, fallbacks and monitoring
* Take ownership of what you ship: deployment, observability, reliability and fixing problems at the root rather than patching symptoms
* Raise issues early, make clear technical decisions, and write them down so the wider team can build on them
* Work with product and design to turn real underwriter workflows into clear, accessible interfaces
* Apply secure development practice as a normal part of the job, in line with our certifications

**What we’re looking for**

* 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering, with production full-stack experience
* Strong Python and TypeScript, with React or a comparable frontend framework
* Experience building data or document processing pipelines that handle messy, real-world inputs
* Good architectural judgement: you can explain trade-offs in performance, cost, maintainability and reliability, and you simplify rather than over-engineer
* Hands-on cloud experience on AWS or GCP, including containers (ECS or Kubernetes), queues or messaging, and infrastructure as code
* Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, and both SQL and NoSQL stores
* A track record of owning services in production: debugging, observability, incident response
* A self-starter mindset: you take a problem from vague to shipped without close supervision
* Clear written communication; you will be working across time zones with a UK and US team

**Useful, not required**

* Experience with LLM applications, vector search or OpenSearch, OCR or document AI tooling
* Exposure to Bedrock, Pub/Sub, Firestore or similar services
* Insurance or related financial services background. Not needed; we will teach the domain.

**What we offer**

* Direct work on a product with live London Market and US customers
* A small team where engineers have real ownership and influence on design
* Competitive Compensation

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on something you have built and run in production to shravan@genairate.io.

**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
At HPE Networking, the Digital Experience & Automation (DEA) team is reimagining how people experience support and services in a digital‑first world -- setting new standards for the future of networking. We enable customers, partners, and employees through AI‑driven tools and modern platforms, transforming support into a unified, efficient, and simple experience that drives measurable value. Our work is fuelled by a passion for self‑service, intelligent automation, and building digital experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and human‑centric.

* Database design and Postgres SQL
* Docker and containers
* Experience of using cloud platforms like AWS
* KnexJS
* Jest Testing Framework OR any other testing framework
* Microsoft Visual Studio IDE
* Good written and oral communication skills
* Ability to quickly learn new skills and technologies and work well with other team members

**Education And Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline. Master’s desirable.
* Typically, 6+ years experience.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
