title: Fullstack Engineer (.Net)
description:
**Eurofins Scientific**
is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

**Job Description**

**Experience:**

* 1-4 years of experience with developing end-to-end web applications using Microsoft stack of technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of Web application development using .NET, C#, Asp.net, MVC, WebAPI.
* Strong Working knowledge of Angular 2 or above, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3.
* Good working knowledge of Cosmos DB, MSSQL – SQL etc.
* Experience with usage of TFS
* Familiar UI testing and Unit Testing (MS Test/ Jasmine/ MOQ/ NUnit/ Karma etc.)
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP)
* Strong working knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns that includes Creational, Structural, Behavioral
* Strong experience in designing and working with n-tier architectures
* Able to provide technical recommendations and solve technical problems
* Should have working knowledge on Code review that includes, raising code review, resolve comment reviews, Closing code reviews.
* Should be aware of best practices in programming
* Should know how to troubleshoot performance-related issues, how to write efficient code and query, how to use SQL profiler
* Working knowledge Authentication and Authorization [Plus OAuth2, OpenIDC etc.] (5+)
* Should have worked on at least one SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) project
* Should have worked in an AGILE practice methodology (preferably SCRUM)

******Additional Information******

**Personal Skills:**

* Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player.

**PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA**
: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

title: Software Engineer – Full Stack, Ruby on Rails/Python/React.js | 4-8 Years | Bangalore
description:

Your Impact
  
  
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with firmware, backend, SRE, and dashboard engineers to architect, design, and build large-scale systems. You will enable connections between over a million network devices and our products. Given our large footprint, quality is our highest priority. **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with container solutions (Kubernetes).

Why Cisco?

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Position:**
Full Stack Developer - Platform & Automation

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
1-3 years

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹4.5 LPA + ESOPs

**About REVERSE**

REVERSE is a cleantech platform building India’s packaging reuse infrastructure. We work across

collection, sorting, sanitization, reverse logistics, and digital traceability to help brands reuse

packaging instead of sending it for unnecessary recycling or disposal.

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can help us build and improve our internal technology

systems, operational dashboards, APIs, databases, and workflow tools. This role is ideal for an

early-career developer who wants hands-on exposure to building real-world systems in a fast-growing

sustainability startup.

**Role Overview**

The selected candidate will work on REVERSE’s core platform and internal tools used for tracking

packaging movement, inventory, sanitization records, dispatches, return-and-reward flows, and

operational reporting. The role will also provide exposure to AI-enabled sorting systems and

automation initiatives, while working closely with the founder, operations team, and technology

advisors.

**Must-Have Skills**

● Hands-on knowledge of full-stack development.

● Experience with frontend and backend development.

● Understanding of API development and API integration.

● Working knowledge of databases, preferably SQL or NoSQL.

● Familiarity with Git/version control.

● Ability to debug, test, and improve existing code.

● Willingness to work in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Preferred Skills**

● React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Firebase, GCP, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or similar

technologies.

● Experience building dashboards, admin panels, workflow tools, or internal applications.

● Basic exposure to cloud deployment.

● Interest in AI, automation, computer vision, sustainability, or supply-chain technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Full Stack Development**

● Build and maintain web applications, internal tools, and operational dashboards for REVERSE’s

reuse operations.

● Work on frontend and backend development for modules related to inventory, collection,

sanitization, dispatch, and reporting.

● Improve existing workflows and build new features based on operational requirements.

**2. Backend, APIs & Integrations**

● Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs.

● Integrate APIs across internal systems, partner workflows, dashboards, and third-party tools

where required.

● Support data flow between different modules such as collection, sorting, sanitization, rewards, and

dispatch tracking.

**3. Database Management**

● Design, maintain, and update databases for operational records, user activity, packaging

movement, inventory, and transaction logs.

● Ensure structured, clean, and secure data handling.

● Write queries and support data extraction for dashboards and reports.

**4. Return & Reward System**

● Support development of REVERSE’s Return & Reward system, including user participation

tracking, packaging return records, reward logic, and redemption flows.

● Build basic admin interfaces and backend logic to support community return campaigns and

brand-linked reuse programs.

**5. Dashboards & Reporting**

● Build dashboards for internal teams, operations, partners, and management review.

● Enable visibility into key metrics such as collection volumes, reusable packaging inventory, reuse

cycles, dispatches, and operational performance.

● Support reporting requirements for internal reviews, grants, investors, and brand partners.

**6. AI & Automation Exposure**

● Support integration of AI/computer vision outputs into internal tools and dashboards.

● Work with senior advisors and technology consultants to understand automation workflows for

sorting and inspection systems.

● Assist in building basic interfaces for reviewing classification outputs, operational exceptions, and

manual validation.

● Get hands-on exposure to automation initiatives while contributing to the supporting software

layer.

**7. Cloud, Deployment & Maintenance**

● Assist in deploying and maintaining applications on cloud platforms such as Firebase, GCP, or

similar environments.

● Support testing, debugging, version control, and basic performance improvements.

● Help maintain system reliability and improve usability of internal tools.

**8. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

● Work closely with operations, growth, and leadership teams to understand field challenges and

convert them into simple product features.

● Take ownership of assigned modules and improve systems based on real-world feedback.

● Maintain basic documentation for code, APIs, workflows, and system updates.

**Ideal Candidate**

● 1–3 years of hands-on development experience.

● Strong fundamentals and willingness to learn quickly.

● Comfortable working with limited structure and taking ownership.

● Can convert business and operations requirements into working software.

● Interested in building technology for climate, sustainability, and circular economy.

**Why Join REVERSE**

● Build technology that solves real-world sustainability and packaging waste challenges.

● Work directly with the founder, operations team, and technology advisors.

● Gain exposure to full stack development, API systems, databases, dashboards, AI-enabled

sorting, and automation workflows.

● Be part of a mission-driven startup building the future of packaging reuse in India.

Greenlight is looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer focused for our Web Core team. This team focuses on core web initiatives including bringing the core Greenlight functionality on the web for the first time and functioning as a horizontal platform team to support other web teams. This includes setting standards, defining best practices, building common libraries and mentoring other web developers. You will be expected to also make contributions to our backend services as required to accomplish the team deliverables.

* Node.js
* React, NextJS, Remix
* REST,Express
* AWS, Kubernetes (EKS)

* Platform - As part of the web core team, you will have to support all web development within Greenlight. This includes providing mentorship and support for web teams, defining standards, best practices and determining technologies
* Working in a strong team to quickly deliver on our web products.
* Work with product and design teams to continuously add incremental features while balancing new features and tech debt
* Scaling and maintaining our backend services to evolve with new feature requests and support our growing user base
* Improving the reliability and availability of the platform which supports our families and partners

**What you’ll bring to the team:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* 6+ years software development experience

* An eye towards performance, scalability, and observability
* Experience building single page applications using a modern framework
* Experience building REST apis
* Recent experience building backend services using node.js

**Preferred experience:**

* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation

**The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with**
**Standard India**
A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture, focused on operational excellence, thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Standard is seeking a
**Full‑Stack Software Engineer III**
with strong skills in
**Angular**
on the front end and
**Java/Spring Boot**
on the back end to build secure, modern experiences and services for our Employer Portal. You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Product Analysts, Scrum Masters, Front‑End and Back‑End Engineers, SDETs, Data Engineers, DevOps/SRE, and UX to deliver enterprise‑grade capabilities that power customer‑facing applications
  
  
As a Full-Stack Software Engineer III, you will work with general instructions to build highly scalable and reliable front-end and back-end services, including UIs and REST APIs, using Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, our in-house design system comprising web components, and Java/Spring Boot to deliver digital capabilities to customers. You will use your front- and back-end expertise to identify solutions and contribute to innovation by advancing best ‑ in ‑ class software engineering patterns and methodologies that can transform business processes. Additionally, you will develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, reliable, and efficient deployments, working within Azure DevOps and GitHub to support streamlined development workflows.
  
  

* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, India is a requirement of the role.

**Mode of Working: This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on-site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment.**
**Skills And Background You’ll Need**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or Information Systems is required.
  
  
**Experience:**
Typically requires 5+ years of related experience.
  
  

* Experience implementing front-end design patterns using frameworks like Angular or React
* Experience implementing Java API design patterns using frameworks like Spring Boot
* Experience optimizing applications for speed, responsiveness, and maintainability
* Experience pre-processing multi-modal data (text, images) to handle user input, cleaning and formatting text
* Experience with containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes on Azure platform
* Experience developing and implementing in Microsoft Azure
* Experience implementing or working with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
* Working within an Agile delivery / DevOps methodology to deliver proof of concept and production implementation in iterative sprints
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
* Strong data background with experience in integrating with databases (SQL and NoSQL)
* Experience configuring and implementing Azure Application Gateway and API management solutions like Kong Konnect preferred
* Experience working with event driven publish-subscribe solution patterns using solutions like Azure Event Hub or Kafka and developing end-to-end orchestrations preferred

**Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate**

* Adaptability – Seeks information to understand the rationale for and importance of the change
* Customer Focus – Displays an interest in the customer by trying to understand their concerns and issues; draws on customer insight to help others best meet current and future customer needs.
* Improvement Mindset - Demonstrates curiosity by asking questions regarding current approaches/methods and identifying potential changes.

**Why Join**
Standard India?
  
  
We Have Built An Enduring Legacy Of Stability, Financial Strength And Exceptional Customer Service Through The Contributions Of The Service-oriented People Who Choose To Work At The Standard. To Ensure We Can Attract And Retain The Best Talent, When You Join StanCorp Global Servicesyou Can Expect
  
  

* A rich benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial goals
* An annual incentive bonus plan tied to both individual and organizational performance
* Paid time off including earned leave, sick/casual leave, and public holidays, in accordance with the company’s leave policy
* A supportive, responsive management approach that empowers you to grow
* Opportunities for career advancement through learning, coaching, and leadership enablement
* A culture where your voice matters—your ideas shape our future, and we win as one
* Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for our customers, communities, and each other

In addition to a competitive salary, our employee-focused benefits are designed to support work-life balance, personal growth, and long-term impact.
  
  
*Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.*
StanCorp Global Services India Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, caste, HIV status or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws of India.

title: Engineer II, Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose:**

* Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships.
* EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users.
* The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision.
* Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership.
* Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads.

**Required skills:**

* 6+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments.
* Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features.
* Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production.
* Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject.
* A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted.

**Education :**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred skills:**

* Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler.
* Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX.
* Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Amazon Web Services (AWS), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Full Stack Development, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Machine Learning (ML)
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: Software Development Engineer III, Bangalore
description:
**About Broccoli**

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

* Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.
* **We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.**
* We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.
* **We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.**

We're still just getting started.

**SDE III @ Broccoli**

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the AI intelligence layer that runs front-office operations for home service businesses. You’ll work on systems that don’t just generate responses—but take real actions like booking jobs, dispatching technicians, and driving revenue.

This is a product engineering role. You won’t just write code—you’ll shape how the product works in the real world, talking to customers, understanding edge cases, and shipping quickly.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build end-to-end features across backend and frontend that directly impact customer revenue
* Work closely with design, product, and GTM to ship features from idea to production
* Translate real-world workflows (calls, scheduling, dispatch) into scalable systems
* Improve system reliability, performance, and developer velocity as we scale
* Learn fast by working directly with customers and iterating based on real usage

**What You’ll Bring**

* 4-8 years of experience building & shipping products
* Strong fundamentals across backend and frontend systems
* High ownership—you don’t wait for specs, you figure things out
* Curiosity for how real businesses operate, not just how software works
* Ability to move fast without breaking things that matter

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office
  
  
Do you have a passion for innovative ideas and groundbreaking discoveries? With over $1 billion invested annually in R&D, at Thermo Fisher Scientific you’ll help solve some of the world’s toughest challenges, from giving cancer patients hope, ensuring safe drinking water and helping law enforcement tackle cases through forensics. We empower our teams to put science into meaningful action and give our R&D colleagues the autonomy, resources and tools they need to take science a step beyond.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
You will be part of an innovative software team that develops instrument software that control an instrument and allows scientists to interact with instrument features intuitively. You will work closely with product managers and engineering teams around the world to develop the instrument. You will work on sophisticated solutions using full stack technology and reusable UI components.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement features based on requirements and specifications.
* Well verse in object-oriented programming and functional code design.
* Develop a novel UX, implementing the design provided by an internal team
* Development and support of GUI, analysis, communications, and instrument control software
* Integration of algorithms & mathematical functions for identification and quantification of data collected by instruments
* Understand the business needs, analyze the workflows, and carry out integrations across different sub-components.

**How You Will Get Here**

description:

title: Software Development Engineer 4
description:
**Job Title**
Software Development Engineer 4
  
  
**Summary Of The Role**
Are you experienced in full stack development and interested in application security? Join the Engineering Team in Amadeus Security Management as a Full Stack Development Engineer, where you'll develop your expertise across backend services, data, analytics, frontend technologies and DevOps.
  
  
You'll contribute to SIGHT (Security InsiGHTs), our strategic extended Security Posture Management (xSPM) platform. SIGHT aggregates, analyzes and visualizes security, compliance and engineering data across the organization.
  
  
The platform provides dashboards, reporting and automation that help management, security teams, compliance specialists, DevSecOps teams and engineers monitor and improve security posture.
  
  
SIGHT supports Amadeus Security Management by transforming security, compliance and engineering data into actionable metrics and visual dashboards, supporting informed decisions, audits and governance activities.
  
  
You'll contribute across Python services and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), data pipelines, Microsoft Power BI dashboards, Microsoft Fabric assets, frontend components and DevOps delivery pipelines.

* Develop and maintain SIGHT's Python backend services, frontend components and Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs, creating reliable and maintainable product capabilities.
* Build reporting interfaces, visual analytics, Microsoft Fabric dataflows and pipelines that integrate security, compliance and enterprise data for reliable and scalable reporting.
* Design and implement appropriate Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted automation and use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency.
* Apply Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Podman, while contributing to technical documentation, release notes and production support.

* Relevant education, training, or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, systems engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.
* Practical knowledge or experience in secure software development or application security.
* Relevant training or certifications in Python, cloud technologies, DevOps, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, or data engineering can complement practical experience.

**Reporting line**
You will report to the SEU Manager and work closely with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and the SIGHT Scrum team.

* 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

* 🤗 A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* 🌟 A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* 🌈 A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
* 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.
  
  
Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
**🏢 About The Company**
GreedyGame, founded in 2013 by Arpit Jain (CEO), is a leading ad-tech company driving app growth and monetization.
  
  
We’ve built a sustainable, profitable business for over 7 years without chasing vanity metrics. The 0→1 journey is done, and we’re now scaling through the 1→10 phase.
  
  
As a Google Publishing Partner, we serve 100M+ daily ad impressions and support 5,000+ apps and games worldwide, delivering up to 75% revenue uplift.
  
  
Trusted by Amazon, Dream11, MPL, Sharechat, Treebo, Mobikwik, and 1000+ publishers across 20+ countries.
  
  
**📦 The products you’ll own**
📊 Pubscale: Monetization, user acquisition, revenue uplift, and business-growth analysis in a single place.
  
  
📱 Immersive Ads: Native, non-intrusive ad formats. Smart caching, priority loading, and adaptive refresh deliver better UX and higher monetization without annoying popups.
  
  
🎁 Offerwall: A reward-based engagement layer that monetizes non-paying users through personalized, high-conversion tasks, driving eCPMs up to $1000 in Tier 1 geos and up to 3X more revenue in emerging markets.
  
  
📈 AdX & GROW: Monetization via Google Ad Manager and premium demand partners, plus an AI-driven UA engine (GROW) with free credits and optimization support.
  
  
**🎯 What You’ll Do**

* Own product surfaces end to end. Take publisher and internal dashboards (ad unit management, mediation, reporting, monitoring, operational workflows) from a product brief to production. That covers the React screens, the Go APIs, and the data model behind them.
* Set the frontend bar. Define how we structure components, manage state and server data, handle loading, empty, and error states, and keep data-heavy pages fast, accessible, and responsive.
* Build and evolve our design system. Grow a shared component library (tables, filters, date-range pickers, charts, forms) so teams ship consistent UI faster.
* Design the APIs the UI needs. Write and extend Go services, shape response contracts for the client, and make sensible calls on pagination, aggregation, caching, and where computation should live.
* Work with the data layer. Model and query PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, and work with analytical stores for reporting. Spot slow queries and N+1 patterns before they reach users.
* Make it reliable. Add monitoring, error tracking, and tests where they matter. Debug production issues across the stack and drive fixes to the root cause.
* Raise the team’s level. Review code, mentor interns and junior engineers, write clear technical proposals, and explain tradeoffs to product and engineering.

**🔎 What We’re Looking For**

* 4–5 years building production web applications, with most of that time in React.
* Deep React and TypeScript: hooks, composition, performance profiling, memoization, and when to reach for a state or data-fetching library such as React Query or Redux, and when not to.
* Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals: layout, responsive design, accessibility (a11y), and attention to visual detail.
* A track record of shipping complex tables, filters, charts, and dashboards over large datasets, with virtualization, pagination, and efficient re-rendering.
* Hands-on backend experience in Go (or solid experience in another backend language and a willingness to go deep in Go): REST APIs, concurrency basics, testing.
* Comfort with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and MongoDB, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
* Experience with the delivery basics: Git workflows, CI/CD, code reviews, and production debugging.
* Ownership: you scope work, flag risks early, and see features through to adoption.

✨
**Bonus points**

* Built or maintained a design system or component library.
* Charting experience (Recharts, ECharts, D3, Highcharts) and data-visualization sense.
* ClickHouse or BigQuery for analytics and reporting workloads.
* Ad-tech, analytics, or B2B SaaS dashboard experience.
* Frontend performance work: bundle splitting, Core Web Vitals, rendering large datasets.
* Experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or AI-assisted product features.
* Startup experience or meaningful freelance or open-source work.

**🤝 What Makes You a Great Fit**

* You think in screens, flows, and the job a publisher is trying to get done, and you push back when a flow doesn’t serve that job.
* You write a clean, maintainable React and care about the details users actually notice.
* You’re as comfortable opening a Go handler or a slow query as you are a component file, and you’ll build the API when the UI needs something that isn’t there yet.
* You make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed and quality and explain them clearly.
* You enjoy helping other engineers grow and leave codebases better than you found them.

**🚀 Why GreedyGame**

* Work on products used by millions, including Pubscale.
* Real ownership of the screens and services that publishers and internal teams rely on every day.
* A direct line to the CTO and a seat at the table on technical direction.
* A learning stipend for books, courses, and conferences (we love curious minds), plus internal blogs.
* Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, PTO, parental leave, and more.
* A high-growth, inclusive, engineering-led culture that supports experimentation and impact.

We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
  
  
**About Your Team**
Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.
  
  
Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.
  
  
As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.
  
  
You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.
  
  
The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

**Software Engineering**

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

**Architecture & Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About You**
We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on AI Engineer who combines strong full-stack engineering capability with practical experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You are comfortable taking AI-powered applications and services through design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support within established architecture and engineering standards.
  
  
You are naturally curious about emerging technologies, enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, and apply AI pragmatically to improve business outcomes and developer productivity without compromising software quality, security, governance, or Responsible AI principles.
  
  
You are comfortable contributing to architectural and technical discussions with senior engineers, collaborating with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, and engaging with investment stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions.
  
  
**Software Engineering Experience**

* 6+ years experience in software engineering, including experience leading the technical delivery of complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrable experience building, deploying, and supporting production Generative AI or LLM-powered applications.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and at least one modern frontend stack using TypeScript with Angular / React.
* Experience developing APIs and distributed services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.

* Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions.
* Excellent understanding of modern software engineering principles and design patterns.
* Experience working within Agile software delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, software quality and secure software development practices.
* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

**AI Engineering Experience**

* Practical experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf or similar LLM-based engineering assistants.
* Experience integrating AI into software engineering workflows including code generation, documentation, automated testing, code review and developer productivity.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and effective techniques for interacting with Large Language Models.
* Familiarity with emerging AI concepts such as AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic development workflows.
* Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI practices and the effective use of AI within enterprise engineering environments.
* Passion for staying current with developments in AI-assisted software engineering.

**Technical Skills**
Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:
  
  

* Python, Angular, Nodejs, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
* LLM application development and prompt engineering
* Enterprise RAG and vector search
* AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Git-based source control and collaborative development workflows
* REST APIs and event-driven architectures
* CI/CD tooling

**Investment Management Experience**

* Experience working closely with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers or front-office technology teams.
* Understanding of the governance, control and regulatory expectations associated with investment management technology.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passionate about engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Naturally curious about emerging technologies and AI.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Collaborative and delivery-focused.
* Pragmatic approach to balancing innovation with governance.

* Enthusiastic about helping others adopt new technologies and ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Now
description:
**Description**
Do you want to invent a brand-new quick-commerce platform from the ground up? Amazon Now is building the future of 10-minute delivery for India's fast-growing grocery and essentials market, and we're looking for talented engineers who want to do more than write code — you'll own components that thousands of customers touch within minutes of a change going live, and help shape the product, the architecture, and the business roadmap. This is not maintenance work; it's a high-visibility, grounds-up initiative where you'll design and build the entire shopping lifecycle — discovery, storefront, ordering, and delivery — using modern ReactJS front-ends and backend services built from scratch.
  
  
You'll work alongside senior engineers and product leaders to solve difficult, ambiguous problems at scale, making pragmatic trade-offs without over-engineering. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your work directly influences both the technology and the customer experience on a platform designed to scale beyond India, this is the role for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver complex, scalable components of the quick-commerce platform end-to-end, spanning discovery, storefront, ordering, and delivery experiences
* Contribute actively to the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and operational support for production systems
* Make sound architecture and trade-off decisions on technology choices, dependencies, and resource efficiency, balancing speed of iteration with long-term maintainability and quality
* Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and customer needs into technical solutions that deliver measurable impact
* Ensure operational excellence by identifying and resolving root causes of issues, raising the engineering bar on reliability and scaling, and sharing knowledge through code reviews

A day in the life
  
  
Your day blends inventing and building stable, performant software with your team through pragmatic design discussions and thorough code reviews. You'll make critical architecture decisions — whether to reuse existing components or build new ones, which dependencies to adopt, how to optimize for resource efficiency — while pairing with senior engineers on complex technical challenges. You'll collaborate directly with customers and stakeholders to refine project ideas, then move quickly under a build-fast, iterate-fast model without compromising on quality or operational discipline.
  
  
**About The Team**
We're the India Grocery & Everyday Essentials team building Amazon Now — a grounds-up quick-commerce experience for India's fast-growing 10-minute-delivery market. Our team of senior engineers and product leaders is creating industry-leading shopping experiences spanning discovery through delivery. We value high ownership, a proactive approach, and the highest engineering standards, and we move fast and iterate quickly.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Application Engineer

Due to the highly regulated nature of our industry, successful candidates may undergo enhanced background checks and security screenings. MongoDB is committed to providing a supportive, enriching work environment with a focus on employee wellbeing and growth.
  
  
Why MongoDB?
  
  
Join us in transforming the way enterprises manage and scale data. MongoDB provides a dynamic workplace culture with employee affinity groups, fertility assistance, and generous parental leave policies, ensuring an inclusive experience.

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Three engineers, joining a team of five that owns everything this company runs on. No senior-free team — two senior engineers are already here. No QA function — you test what you ship.**

**THE DATES THAT CANNOT MOVE:**

* **In-person interview:**
  20–30 November 2026, at our Bengaluru office. It cannot be done online.
* **Applications close:**
  15 November 2026. We may close early once the positions are filled.
* **Joining date:**
  1 December 2026. Non-negotiable.

You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception.

**Please read this advertisement to the end before you apply. It is long on purpose — it tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, and what we will not budge on.**

**WHO WE ARE:**

Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service — a subscription model in which we take over a client’s procurement function entirely.

We run three companies across India, Hong Kong and the UAE. We are bootstrapped, no outside funding and none being sought, and people here own real things early.

**THE ROLE:**

**We are hiring three full-stack engineers to join our in-house engineering team. There are two senior engineers here already. The three of you would make it a team of five, and between you that team is responsible for everything this company runs on.**

The main build is the SCaaS platform — the software the subscription business runs on, and the system our clients use. Broadly it covers the client-facing side where a customer raises a requirement and watches it move; the sourcing side where suppliers are matched, quotes compared and decisions recorded; and the operations side underneath — fulfilment, documentation, landed cost, and the integrations that keep everything in step.

Alongside it sit our hiring and assessment platform and our marketing tooling, both already running, and whatever we decide to build next. Five people, several products.

**Which part you own is decided after you join, not before.**
We are not allocating modules at offer stage — we would be guessing, and we would probably guess wrong. The first few weeks are how we find out where each of you is strongest. Apply as a full-stack engineer, not as a specialist in one corner; all three of you are assessed the same way.

**One thing we want to be honest about.**
Five engineers carrying three platforms is a broad surface for a small team. You will context-switch more than you would at a larger company, you will work outside whatever you consider your specialism, and some weeks the priority will change under you.

**There is also no QA function. You test what you ship. Code review is real — our two senior engineers and your peers review everything, nobody merges their own work including the founder, and AI-assisted architecture and security review runs as a formal gate — but nobody downstream is going to catch a bug you did not look for.**

What you get in exchange is unusual at this level: two seniors to learn from, real ownership of a production system from the first month, and your work in front of paying clients. If the work grows faster than five people can carry, we expect to hire again around March.

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

* Build and ship to production, weekly. We would rather see something working on Friday than something perfect next month.
* Own your part of the platform — its architecture, uptime, backups, security, and the decisions about where it goes next.
* Test your own work. There is no QA function here and we are not pretending otherwise.
* Review code and have yours reviewed, by the senior engineers and by your peers.
* Integrate substantial third-party APIs, primarily the Zoho suite, and LLM APIs for the AI tooling we run internally.
* Demo working software to the Managing Director every Friday. Thirty minutes, running software, not a status update.
* Write things down — standards, decisions and runbooks — so the next person is not reverse-engineering your head.

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

Rs 40,000 to Rs 45,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on what you can demonstrate you have built. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.

* Compensation reviewed formally at six and twelve months, against evidence. We would rather pay well to keep someone who has become valuable than re-hire and start again.
* A laptop, the tools you need including AI tooling, and a learning budget.
* PF and ESI as per statute.

We will be straight with you: this is not the top of the Bengaluru market, and if your only measure is the number on the offer, you will do better elsewhere. What is unusual here is the ownership and the proximity. At one to three years you would be responsible for a production system that a paying business depends on, working directly with two senior engineers and the founder, with your work in front of clients. That is rare, and it compounds faster than a salary does.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **MANDATORY —**
  something you have actually shipped, that we can look at: a GitHub profile with real commits, or a live URL. An application without it will not be reviewed.
* You can read code you did not write and work out what is wrong with it. With five engineers across several products, you will spend real time in code that is not yours.
* 1 to 3 years building and shipping web applications. This is not a fresher role.
* One modern JavaScript or TypeScript front-end framework, to a working professional standard.
* A back end in Python or Node, and the ability to design a sensible relational database schema.
* Experience integrating a REST API from a large third-party platform — Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, a payment gateway, anything substantial.
* You have deployed something yourself and kept it running. Not just pushed to a branch.
* Git discipline, and the ability to explain your own code clearly to someone else. We will ask you to.

**Nice to have, not required -**

* LLM and AI API integration — prompt design, output handling, evaluating what comes back. The Zoho ecosystem: Deluge, Creator, Catalyst. Authentication, access control and handling sensitive data properly. Having been the first or only engineer somewhere.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.

* You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.
* You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.
* You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining. We do not pay relocation costs or a joining bonus.
* You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.
* Your experience is entirely in notebooks or coursework and you have never shipped a product users touched.
* You have never deployed anything or owned anything in production.
* You want a backlog handed to you each morning. You will be given problems, not tickets.
* You want to work on one product, or only on research and prototyping. Everything you build here is meant to be used.
* You cannot explain code you wrote six months ago.

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

Four rounds. We have deliberately kept the unpaid work small.

1. **Application —**
   short questions and your GitHub or live project link. The link is mandatory.
2. **Technical test —**
   timed, online, around 60 minutes. Finding and explaining bugs in code you did not write, plus written reasoning about how you would structure a system.
3. **Video interview —**
   recorded, online. You explain your own answers from the technical test.
4. **In-person with the Managing Director —**
   at our Bengaluru office, 20–30 November. Includes walking us through code you have written — bring it, and expect to be asked why, repeatedly.

**On AI: use it.**
We do, you will be building with LLM APIs here, and an engineer who refuses the tools is not who we are looking for in 2026. What we test instead is whether you understand what you produced. The technical test asks you to find bugs in code you did not write, which no assistant can do for you without you understanding the code. Rounds three and four ask you to account for your own work. Code you cannot explain is worth nothing to us.

All online rounds complete by 19 November. We make offers on a rolling basis — if you are strong, you will hear from us quickly.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Apply through the link on this posting and answer the application questions in full. Attach your CV, your GitHub or live project link, and a short covering note in your own words — not a template.

Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd · Bengaluru, India.

(We hire on evidence and demonstrated work, and we welcome applications from every background.)

title: Lead Salesforce Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
Elastic is looking for a Lead Salesforce Engineer who combines deep architectural intuition, clean coding, and sharp debugging skills with an AI-native workflow using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex across the entire stack. Adaptable and deeply curious, you will dive into platforms like Salesforce and MuleSoft while holding an end-to-end ownership mindset to elevate engineering practices and turn ambiguous business challenges into high-quality, reliable production solutions. In this role, success goes beyond ticket counts; you will streamline critical revenue processes, scale platform architecture, and leverage AI to build smart automations that eliminate manual work, serving as a key technical partner driving meaningful business impact.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end — UI, APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations — with a strong bias for clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
* Build modern frontend experiences (component-based UI, responsive design) and robust backend services and APIs, applying solid object-oriented and software design principles.
* Use AI-assisted development tools — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — throughout the SDLC: scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and code review, while maintaining engineering rigor over AI-generated output.
* Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, and enterprise integration practices.
* Where the work runs on Salesforce, develop using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, and the platform's security model — with support to ramp up if you're new to the platform.
* Explore and build agentic and AI-powered features (e.g., Agent Builder, workflow automation, AI agents) that bring real automation and intelligence into business processes, with appropriate governance and human-in-the-loop checks.
* Own features through the full lifecycle: solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies; and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.

**What You Bring:**

* 12+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience — strong fundamentals across frontend, backend, APIs, and data.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Proficiency in modern frontend technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, modern frameworks) and backend development (object-oriented programming, RESTful API design, databases/SQL, data modeling).
* Hands-on, daily experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — able to write precise prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and performance.
* Solid grounding in software design patterns, SDLC, Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently design and deliver scalable technical solutions.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Bonus Points:**

* A true engineer at heart: someone who can reason about architecture, write clean code, and diagnose hard bugs — with or without AI in the loop.
* Genuinely AI-native: you reach for Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex by default, and use them to build fluency across the stack, not just in your specialty.
* Curious and adaptable — comfortable picking up new platforms (including Salesforce, Mulesoft) quickly when the work calls for it.
* Ownership mindset: you drive features to done, care about quality, and elevate the engineers around you.
* Excited about applying AI meaningfully to real business problems — automation, decision support, and smarter workflows
* Take ambiguous business problems and turn them into production solutions.
* Reduce friction in critical revenue processes.
* Improve the reliability and scalability of our platform.
* Deliver solutions faster without sacrificing engineering quality.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation and AI.
* Become a trusted technical partner for business stakeholders.
* Leave our architecture and engineering practices better than you found them.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep large-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kael” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Full-Stack Robotics Engineer who can take a robotic or sensor system from a blank sheet to a working product. You will work across the whole stack: mechanical design, electronics and firmware, and robot software (ROS, navigation and perception). If you have built a real robot or sensor platform from the ground up and love debugging it in the field, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design & build: Take hardware products from concept to prototype to production, integrating multiple sensors such as LiDAR, cameras and IMUs.
* Robot software: Develop and maintain ROS/ROS2 nodes in C++ and Python, including navigation, path planning, localisation and sensor-driver integration.
* Electronics & firmware: Design and bring up interfaces and sensor boards using UART, I2C, SPI and microcontrollers (Arduino, STM32 or similar); write and debug embedded code.
* Mechanical design: Create 3D models, assemblies and manufacturing drawings in SolidWorks and AutoCAD; select materials and components; work with vendors on fabrication.
* Integration & testing: Bridge hardware and software, run field trials, and find the root cause of issues across mechanical, electrical and software layers.
* Collaboration: Work with the AI, computer vision and software teams to turn product requirements into robust, scalable systems that perform in real-world site conditions.
* Ownership: Document designs, own technical decisions for your subsystem, and help shape the future of our product line.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 2–3 years of hands-on work in robotics, autonomous systems, sensors or automation.
* Built from scratch: Has designed and built at least one complete product or system end to end (robot, scanner, AGV/AMR, sensor rig or similar) and can explain every design decision.
* ROS & C++: Strong working experience with ROS/ROS2 and C++; comfortable with Python.
* Navigation: Practical knowledge of path planning and the ROS Navigation Stack (Nav2/move\_base), including mapping and localisation.
* Electronics: Solid understanding of electronic components and circuits; working knowledge of UART, I2C and microcontroller platforms such as Arduino.
* Mechanical CAD: Proficiency in SolidWorks and AutoCAD for part design, assemblies and drawings.
* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Science or a related field.
* Mindset: A sharp problem-solver who digs into root causes, learns new tools quickly and works independently.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with multi-sensor systems (LiDAR, cameras, IMUs, thermal) and sensor calibration or time synchronisation.
* Hands-on SLAM or registration-based mapping pipelines.
* Background in autonomous vehicles, warehouse automation, AMR/AGV, drones or sensor-motor control.
* PCB design (KiCad, Altium or Eagle), 3D printing/prototyping, and design-for-manufacturing exposure.
* Embedded Linux, Jetson or Raspberry Pi-class platforms, and CAN/SPI/Ethernet protocols.
* A portfolio, GitHub, demo videos or shipped products to show your work.

**Work Location : Bangalore (On-site)**

title: Senior Software Engineer-Fullstack
description:
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a
**Senior Software Engineer**
to build reliable, intuitive, and scalable full-stack products for Member Records, the care-team-member-facing context layer within CareHub. Member Records surfaces the right member information at the right moment so each care-team interaction is informed and actionable, reducing the need to search across fragmented systems.
  
  
The experience brings together the context care-team members need to support a member, including member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indication, and history. Current product work also includes helping care-team members understand device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions, especially when a member is active in more than one program.
  
  
**Member Records**
is part of the broader Member Record & Configurator pod. The adjacent Configurator experience gives physical therapists a way to review and personalize exercise therapy programs, while Member Records provides the member context needed to make those decisions.
  
  
You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to turn complex workflows into simple experiences. You will contribute from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys owning meaningful product areas end to end, makes sound technical trade-offs, and raises the quality of the systems and team around them.
  
  
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Design and deliver full-stack features using TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
* Build maintainable frontend experiences, backend services, APIs, and data models for member-record workflows.
* Translate ambiguous product and workflow requirements into clear technical designs and incremental delivery plans.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and partner engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Improve the reliability, performance, security, observability, and maintainability of production systems.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code and contribute to effective testing strategies across the stack.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, incident response, and operational improvements.
* Identify technical debt and make pragmatic improvements that help the team move faster safely.
* Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, thoughtful reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
* Use modern developer and AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development quality and productivity.

**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
  
  
**This is a Bengaluru-based role**
that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
  
  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).
* Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree
* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software.
* 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development.
* 3+years backend experience with Node.js, service development, API design, and integration patterns.
* 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
* Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS
* Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization,
* Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices.
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
* A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows.

**About Hinge Health**
At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.
  
  
As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/
  
  
**What You'll Love About Us**

* Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).
* Well-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.
* Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

**Culture & Engagement**
Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.
  
  
By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.
  
  
Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

**users, product data, design, and the founding team**

The product sits at the intersection of
**AI, video creation, and editing**

You’ll work closely with the

  Build systems that evaluate outputs across technical quality, brand alignment, pacing, and overall video quality.

  Talk to users, understand how they actually use the product, and translate those insights directly into engineering decisions.

  **full-stack engineering ability**

  .
