title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Data & AI
description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses
  
  

* Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !
  
  
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
  
  
The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
(FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.
* Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way.
* AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders.
* Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact.
* Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date.
* AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours.
* Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time.
* Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap.
* Architecture Standards & Playbooks: Demonstrated expertise in establishing system frameworks like the Agent Development Kit (ADK), authoring operational playbooks, and drafting technical guidelines. 1 2
* Reusable Assets Contribution: Strong background in modular architectures, ensuring custom-built implementations are published as reusable internal marketplace assets instead of isolated, unmanaged components.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 6 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you’ve already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You’re imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems.
* Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless.
* Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth.
* Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
  
  
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.
  
  
Love this job and want to apply?
  
  
Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
  
  
Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
  
  
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
  
  
WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Telnyx**
*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a*
*private, global, multi-cloud IP network*
*, to bringing*
*hyperlocal edge*
*technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.*
*We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.*
*Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.*
**The Role**
We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Bangalore — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.
  
  
This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.
  
  
You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.
  
  
*The Pod Model*
*Enterprise AE*
— owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.
  
  
*Forward Deployed Engineer*
— owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.
  
  
We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
* Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
* Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like BharatGPT, OpenHathi, or other Indic-language sovereign models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
* Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
* Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
* Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
* Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
* Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
* Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for English and Indic language use cases (Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and other regional languages) and India-specific regulatory environments (DPDP Act, data localization, RBI cloud regulations)
* Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
* Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
* Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from India
* Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

**What We're Looking For**

* CS degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
* Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
* Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
* Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
* You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
* High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
* You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
* Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
* Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
* Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
* Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
* Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
* Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across India
* Legally authorized to work in India, or eligible for sponsorship

*Bonus Points For*

* Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
* Building eval sets for a specific domain
* Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
* Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including Indic-language models (BharatGPT, OpenHathi, Bhashini, Sarvam AI) and Indian sovereign AI initiatives
* Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
* SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
* ETL and data wrangling experience
* CI/CD pipeline design and automation
* Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
* Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and Indian regulatory frameworks (DPDP Act, data localization under IT Rules, RBI cloud and data residency requirements, MeitY AI governance guidelines)
* Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

description:
Full Stack Developer (.NET + SQL)

**.NET / C# + SQL Server | React / Angular | Full Stack Web Applications**

Location: India (Hybrid)| Business Unit: Data, Analytics & AI | Employment Type: Full-time |Function: Software Engineering

About Us

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM's 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT—a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world's leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025—Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing web applications that power our data, analytics, and AI solutions for global enterprise clients. In this role, you will own features end to end, from responsive, intuitive user interfaces built with React or Angular to robust back-end services and APIs built on .NET, backed by well-designed SQL databases. You will work closely with product owners, designers, data engineers, and QA teams in an Agile environment to deliver production-ready software that creates measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

* **Back-End Development:**
  Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs, microservices, and business logic using C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core Web API, and Entity Framework Core, applying clean architecture and SOLID principles.
* **Front-End Development:**
  Build responsive, accessible, and reusable UI components using React or Angular with TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3; integrate front-end applications with back-end services and manage application state effectively.
* **Database Design & Development:**
  Design normalized schemas and write optimized SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions in SQL Server (or equivalent RDBMS); tune query performance through indexing and execution-plan analysis.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:**
  Translate business requirements into technical designs, estimate effort, and deliver features across the full stack, from database to UI, with a strong focus on quality, performance, and security.
* **Code Quality & Testing:**
  Write unit and integration tests (xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Jasmine), participate in peer code reviews, and follow secure coding practices including authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT).
* **CI/CD & Collaboration:**
  Use Git for version control and contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and support production deployments and troubleshooting.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* **Overall Experience:**
  Minimum 5 years of professional experience in full stack software development, with hands-on delivery of enterprise-grade web applications.
* **Mandatory Back-End Skills:**
  Strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core (Web API / MVC), and Entity Framework Core, including building and consuming RESTful APIs.
* **Mandatory Database Skills:**
  Advanced SQL proficiency with SQL Server (or equivalent), including complex joins, stored procedures, triggers, indexing, and performance tuning.
* **Mandatory Front-End Skills:**
  Proven hands-on experience building production applications with at least one modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, along with TypeScript/JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.
* **Full Stack Exposure:**
  Demonstrated experience working across both front-end and back-end layers on the same product; candidates with only front-end or only back-end experience will not be considered.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Solid understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, SOLID principles, and microservices or layered architectures, along with Git and Agile methodologies.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Python:**
  Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, data processing, or building lightweight services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Flask).
* **React:**
  Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem (Hooks, Redux or Context API, React Router) is a strong advantage.
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), Docker, Kubernetes, and exposure to integrating AI/ML or analytics services into web applications.

Recognition & Achievements

We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest's North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM's PeMa Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025.

In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services. For more information, please visit our Website: https://www.straive.com/

Equal Opportunity Employer

Straive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

* BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 10+ years work experience or MS with 8+ years of relevant experience.

* Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
* Proven ability to own end-to-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi-service features.

* Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
* Experience on contributing to open-source is a plus.

Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.
  
  
Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. title: Full-Stack Tech Lead – AI Best Practices - Remote
description:
**Company Description**
McFadyen Digital is the leading advisor and implementer of eCommerce Marketplace solutions. During 15 years of implementing marketplaces, we've built dozens of platforms that cumulatively generate billions of dollars of gross merchandise value (GMV). We're honored to have supported 10% of the Fortune 500 with their digital marketplace initiatives. Over 250 global brands like ABB, AB InBev, ACCO, Albertsons, American Red Cross, American Eagle Outfitters, US Army, US Agriculture Dept, (and many more) have entrusted their digital transformations to McFadyen. We operate global offices across the US, Brazil, and India. McFadyen Digital has been a trusted employer for 35 years and believes that people are the most important part of our company. We're proud of our Great Place to Work certification.
  
  
Learn more about us at our website: www.mcfadyen.com
  
  
**About AI Best Practices (AIBP)**
AI Best Practices (ai-best-practices.com) is a knowledge platform and toolset that helps enterprises benchmark and improve how they apply AI across their value chains. It pairs a content-rich Wiki — covering use cases, AI tools, ROI frameworks, and industry categorization — with Librarian, an AI-driven backend that curates, scores, and surfaces that content. The platform serves C-suite and VP-level decision-makers evaluating AI maturity, tooling, and vendor fit across industries.
  
  
AIBP is a product line built and operated by McFadyen Digital. This role owns the full-stack engineering of the AIBP web application portfolio (Wiki, Librarian, and the surrounding product surface) end-to-end — including how work is planned, ticketed, sequenced, and released.
  
  
**Job Description**
Do you want to own architecture, delivery, and release for a fast-moving AI-native product line — not just write code for one? Can you turn a rough roadmap into a sequence of self-contained, agent-ready Linear tickets without anyone needing to ask a follow-up question? Have you made Claude Code and Claude.ai your daily driver for coding, planning, and ticket-writing, and built your own skills, hooks, or MCP integrations on top of them? Can you judge in seconds when AI-generated code needs a second look — especially around auth, access control, or anything destructive? Do you thrive in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery rather than traditional phased client work? If you answered yes, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
We need a full-stack tech lead to own fast-moving AI-native products end-to-end — and to be the person who turns roadmap into shipped software through well-run Linear tickets, realistic timelines, and clean releases. We build with AI as a first-class part of the workflow: Claude (Claude Code and Claude.ai) is our daily driver for coding, ticket drafting, planning, and status reporting, alongside agentic coding tools, custom skills/hooks/MCP servers, and spec-driven plan/execute/verify loops. You'll work the same way — full-time, hands-on daily, owning architecture, planning, and delivery, and mentoring/reviewing other engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Top 5 responsibilities**

* Own architecture and technical direction across the AIBP web application portfolio — data model, auth/access control, API design, and deployment.
* Ship full-stack features end-to-end — UI, backend logic, schema/migrations, and cloud deploy.
* Plan and run the team's work in Linear as the single source of truth — break initiatives into tickets, sequence them against timelines, and keep status, priority, and dependencies accurate at all times.
* Build and own delivery timelines and project plans, setting realistic estimates for a fast pace and flagging delays and blockers early with a clear cause and recovery plan.
* Own the release process end-to-end — decide what ships, verify migration/deploy readiness, write release notes, and hold the rollback plan.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Write and review tickets so they're self-contained and agent-ready — clear scope, acceptance criteria, and file/test pointers — whether executed by a person or an agentic coding tool.
* Use Claude (Claude Code and Claude.ai) as the default way of writing code, drafting/refining tickets, planning work, and producing status reports.
* Review PRs, mentor other engineers, and set technical and ticket-quality standards.
* Judge when AI output needs verification — especially auth, access control, and destructive data operations.
* Keep tests (unit/integration/E2E) and CI/CD gating healthy as things move fast.
* Report status concisely to stakeholders — what shipped, what's at risk, and what's needed to unblock it.
* Linear & ticket quality: keep Linear accurate as the single source of truth (not a wiki or chat thread); maintain ticket hygiene — status, labels, priority, linked dependencies, sub-issue structure — continuously, not just before a status meeting.
* Timeline & project planning: keep milestones, dependencies, and sequencing visibly current as scope shifts; surface risk and slippage the moment they're known, with a cause and recovery plan attached.
* Release ownership: gate every release through CI/CD and required checks, confirm migration safety, and ensure release notes and a rollback plan exist for every release; run post-release monitoring and any hotfix path.

**Qualifications**
**Top 5 qualifications**

* 8–12 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a lead/ownership capacity.
* Strong TypeScript/React expertise with a modern full-stack framework such as Next.js (deep App Router experience a plus).
* 2+ years of daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools, with Claude (Claude Code and/or Claude.ai) as a true daily driver — not occasional autocomplete.
* Relational database design and ORM experience (Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or similar), with sound judgment on migration safety and cascade behavior.
* Fluency with Linear (or an equivalent issue tracker) as a planning and delivery tool, not just a task list.

**Additional Qualifications**

* REST API design experience: auth boundaries, rate limiting, CSRF protection.
* Solid experience on at least one major cloud/edge platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare) and the judgment to apply it elsewhere.
* CI/CD literacy: gating, required checks, migration safety.
* Session-based auth, RBAC, JWT experience; awareness of CSRF/XSS/injection and secure-by-design habits.
* Testing across the pyramid: mocked unit, real-DB integration, browser E2E (Playwright or equivalent).
* Release management: versioning, changelogs, rollback strategy, deployment gating.
* Has built/customized skills, hooks, subagents, or MCP integrations — extends the tooling, doesn't just consume it.
* Comfortable with spec-driven plan execute verify workflows, including using Claude to draft and refine Linear tickets themselves.
* Uses AI for UI/UX generation and can carry it to production quality.
* Thrives in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery — not traditional estimated client work.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience running Linear as the source of truth across multiple concurrent workstreams or teams.
* CMS-style platforms (admin + public rendering split).
* SEO/AEO/GEO awareness (structured data, sitemaps, AI-crawler design).
* Experience running a smaller companion service alongside a larger app.
* Direct Cloudflare Workers/D1/R2 or Next.js App Router experience.
* Public/OSS contributions in agentic-tooling ecosystems.

**What We Can Offer You**

* A career with thought leaders who literally wrote the book on Marketplace Best Practices.
* A career in the fast-paced world of retail eCommerce, digital marketplaces, and platform businesses.
* A career with first movers who are deploying new business models and strategies worldwide.
* A career in a flat management structure without a rigid hierarchy and bureaucracy.
* A career in a culture that rewards creativity and innovation, risk-taking and teamwork.

**Additional Information**
Our Core Values: Caring, Adaptable, Proactive, Empowering Clients
  
  
Keywords: Claude Code, Claude.ai, MCP, agentic coding, TypeScript, React, Next.js, App Router, Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, Linear, Playwright, CI/CD, RBAC, JWT, Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, GCP, release management
  
  
McFadyen's goal is to ensure that our clients are able to maximize the return on their technology investment by providing better service to their clients, partners and internal teams. At McFadyen we truly believe our employees are our most valuable asset. Across our locations in the US, Brazil, and India, we offer a world class work culture that enables top notch delivery for some of the world's most influential companies.

**About Song - Data & AI**

**What's In It For You?**

* Contribute to Accenture's reusable user-interface components, application services, integration patterns, reference implementations, testing assets, and engineering playbooks.

**What You Will Do**
As a Full Stack Engineering Consultant, you will own the hands-on design, build, testing, deployment, and support of assigned application modules and workstreams. You will create responsive user experiences and scalable services, integrate governed data and ML/AI capabilities, and guide junior team members within agreed architecture, security, and delivery standards.
  
  

* Analyze business, user, and technical requirements and translate them into user stories, acceptance criteria, API contracts, detailed designs, and executable engineering tasks.
* Build responsive, accessible, and reusable web interfaces using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or Next.js.
* Develop secure back-end services, microservices, and APIs using one or more enterprise stacks such as Java and Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js and NestJS, or Python and FastAPI.
* Implement application data models and persistence using relational and NoSQL databases, caching, search, object storage, and messaging services appropriate to the use case.
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems, identity services, APIs, files, event streams, and third-party platforms using synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Apply data engineering know-how to application delivery - including SQL, schema design, data contracts, app-specific ingestion or transformation, data quality checks, lineage awareness, and consumption of lakehouse or warehouse data products.
* Integrate ML and AI capabilities through model endpoints, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings and vector search, agent or tool APIs, structured outputs, feedback capture, and human-in-the-loop workflows in collaboration with ML/AI engineers.
* Implement engineering practices covering Git, code reviews, automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, CI/CD, containerization, cloud deployment, configuration, and release management.
* Design and operate for security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability, and cost; troubleshoot defects and production incidents across the application stack.
* Own an assigned module or workstream, coordinate day-to-day technical activities, review deliverables, and guide Analysts or Senior Analysts.
* Engage client product owners, designers, architects, data teams, and AI teams through requirement workshops, design walkthroughs, sprint reviews, demonstrations, and issue resolution.
* Contribute reusable code, components, technical documentation, reference implementations, and practice knowledge assets.

**Domain Focus**
Candidates should bring hands-on full stack application delivery experience in one or more of the following domains:
  
  

* Marketing - campaign and content workflows, customer data applications, audience activation, personalization, measurement, and next-best-action experiences
* Sales - sales productivity, recommendations, forecasting and revenue intelligence applications, customer or outlet prioritization, and route-to-market tools
* Commerce - product discovery, search and recommendations, catalog, pricing and promotions, order and inventory experiences, and digital commerce platforms
* Service - conversational interfaces, agent assist, knowledge and case management, contact center applications, and operations automation
* Design & Digital Products - responsive web or mobile products, AI copilots, workflow applications, experimentation, product analytics, and reusable digital services

**Who We Are Looking For**
**Mandatory**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4-8 years of progressive experience in full stack application engineering, including ownership of production modules or technical workstreams.
* Strong hands-on expertise in at least one modern front-end stack - React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, JavaScript or TypeScript - together with HTML, CSS, responsive design, and component-based development.
* Strong hands-on expertise in at least one back-end stack - Java and Spring Boot, .NET and C#, Node.js and NestJS or Express, Python and FastAPI, or equivalent.
* Experience designing and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs, microservices, asynchronous workflows, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL, plus working knowledge of NoSQL, caching, search, object storage, or messaging technologies.
* Strong software engineering foundations covering data structures, object-oriented or functional design, clean code, design patterns, version control, code reviews, and automated testing.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one major cloud platform - Azure, AWS, or GCP - and experience with containers, CI/CD pipelines, configuration, secrets, and environment promotion.
* Working knowledge of application security, including authentication and authorization, OAuth2 or OpenID Connect, IAM, secure coding, API protection, encryption, and OWASP risks.
* Experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, error handling, performance optimization, resilience, and production support for distributed applications.
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts - SQL and data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch or streaming integration, schema evolution, data contracts, quality, lineage, and lakehouse or warehouse consumption; Spark familiarity is valuable.
* Working knowledge of ML/AI application integration - model APIs, prompts and structured outputs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, agent or tool-calling patterns, feedback loops, and AI service monitoring.
* Awareness of AI evaluation, hallucination and failure handling, guardrails, privacy, Responsible AI, human oversight, and secure handling of enterprise data in AI-enabled applications.
* Ability to work from a solution architecture and produce detailed designs, API specifications, implementation plans, test evidence, and technical documentation.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery, estimating tasks, tracking dependencies and risks, reviewing work, and mentoring junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical choices to client and cross-functional stakeholders.

**What We Are NOT Looking For**

* Front-end-only or back-end-only profiles without evidence of working across application layers and owning end-to-end integration.
* Low-code, CMS, portal configuration, or packaged-platform profiles without substantive software engineering, automated testing, and production ownership.
* Pure Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or ML Engineers without hands-on experience productizing capabilities through enterprise applications and APIs.
* Prototype- or demonstration-only profiles without experience with security, reliability, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Coordination-only, architecture-only, or delivery-management-only profiles that cannot design, code, review, and troubleshoot application solutions.

title: Senior Specialist, Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The Full Stack AI Engineer is a senior member of Amplify Health’s Technology team, responsible for designing, building and operating secure, production-grade applications within Claims Pro. Claims Pro supports the end-to-end claims value chain, from provider management and eligibility through claims adjudication and payment, through configurable, white-label B2B capabilities that can be adapted to customer and market requirements across Asia, supporting payers, providers, employers and members. The role combines strong full-stack engineering with practical AI delivery, building React and TypeScript front ends in an Nx/Vite workspace, Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs and PostgreSQL-backed data layers, while integrating enterprise AI services, LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing and responsible AI controls into relevant claims workflows. Working closely with Product, Design, architecture, data, DevOps, security and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will translate regulated business and operational requirements and high-value AI opportunities into reliable, scalable, secure, auditable and measurable software capabilities, supporting API-first integrations, healthcare and payer data interoperability, and reliable claims workflows across customers and markets.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Build Full-Stack AI-Enabled Products**

* Design, build, and deploy full-stack AI-enabled applications for Claims Pro using React, TypeScript, Nx and Vite for responsive front-end experiences, and Java/Spring Boot services for secure back-end APIs, workflow integrations and production deployments, supporting configurable capabilities across provider management, eligibility, claims adjudication and payment in line with agreed product requirements.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces, dashboards, conversational experiences, and document-based workflows that embed AI capabilities into real business processes while maintaining accessibility, performance and usability standards.
* Build scalable back-end services, API-first REST APIs, integration layers and PostgreSQL-backed data access patterns using SQL, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC and Flyway to connect AI services and Claims Pro workflows with payer, provider and healthcare systems, using HL7 FHIR and SMART on FHIR interoperability and secure access patterns where applicable.
* Partner with Product, Design, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate claims business and operational requirements and relevant AI opportunities into useful, trusted, secure and measurable product features that can be configured for customer and market needs.

**2) Design and Develop Generative AI, RAG & Agentic Solutions**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI applications using enterprise foundation models and AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or equivalent platforms.
* Build RAG solutions using embeddings, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge sources, secure retrieval patterns, evaluation controls and auditable data access.
* Develop AI agents, copilots, chatbots, and intelligent automation flows that support user productivity, decision support and operational efficiency within governed product workflows.
* Engineer prompts, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks and guardrails to improve model quality, reliability, traceability, safety and business relevance.

**3) Implement Intelligent Document Processing & AI Services**

* Develop document processing solutions using OCR, Azure Document Intelligence, and other AI services to extract, classify, validate, and transform structured and unstructured information.
* Design human-in-the-loop review, feedback, and validation workflows to improve accuracy, explainability, auditability and user trust in AI outputs.
* Integrate AI capabilities such as language understanding, vision, speech, translation, content moderation and analytics into product and business applications where relevant.
* Design secure healthcare and payer data pipelines, schema migrations, validation and data-quality controls, and monitoring patterns to support AI retrieval, analytics, quality measurement and continuous improvement, including bulk data processing and near-real-time claims workflows where required by product requirements.

**4) Deliver Production-Grade Engineering, Cloud Operations & Governance**

* Move AI use cases from prototype to production through robust software engineering practices, including automated testing with Jest/Testing Library and JUnit/Spring Boot testing, code review, CI/CD, release management, monitoring, logging and operational support, embedding privacy, security, performance and observability into development and testing.
* Design secure, scalable and cost-effective cloud-native architectures on Azure or other cloud environments, considering cloud-agnostic service design where appropriate, with observability, performance, latency, configuration, dependency and cost controls to support reliable Claims Pro services and integrations.
* Implement OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication and authorization, secure APIs, sensitive-data handling, Responsible AI, privacy-by-design, auditability, compliance and governance controls suitable for healthcare, financial and insurance systems, aligned with applicable market regulations and secure exchange of healthcare and payer data.
* Monitor application and AI solution quality, reliability, hallucination risk, model performance, user feedback and business impact; support post-launch monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement of Claims Pro applications and mission-critical B2B integrations based on evidence.

**5) Drive Innovation, Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Enablement**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI opportunities in partnership with Product, business, data, security, architecture, DevOps and engineering stakeholders.
* Provide technical recommendations on AI architecture, full-stack engineering patterns, cloud services, security controls, model selection, tooling and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Conduct targeted POCs and pilots with a clear path to production, including success metrics, adoption considerations, operational readiness, scaling plans and risk controls.
* Mentor engineers and stay current with advancements in full-stack engineering, GenAI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, LLM frameworks and healthcare technology trends, translating relevant developments into practical business value.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial end-to-end ownership of production full-stack applications across front-end, back-end, APIs, data layers, cloud services and operations.
* 2+ years of practical experience building AI, GenAI, LLM, RAG, intelligent automation or data-driven applications, preferably in enterprise or regulated environments.
* Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and React, including component architecture, routing, state management, forms, schema validation, frontend performance and accessibility, with hands-on experience in Nx and Vite preferred.
* Strong Java and Spring Boot experience building secure REST services, with practical knowledge of validation, exception handling, OpenAPI documentation and service-layer design.
* Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including experience with JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, schema migrations, transaction management and query optimisation.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into user-facing products, workflows, dashboards, conversational interfaces, document-processing journeys or operational tools.
* Practical experience with foundation models and enterprise AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or equivalent platforms.
* Experience implementing RAG solutions using embeddings, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge sources, and appropriate retrieval and evaluation patterns.
* Experience moving software or AI solutions from prototype to production using engineering practices such as automated testing, code review, Git, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, release management and operational support.
* Experience with OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication and authorization, secure coding, API integration and common application security practices.
* Required: hands-on experience in financial services, insurance, healthcare or other regulated data environments, with a strong understanding of sensitive data, security, auditability and operational controls.
* Preferred: experience with health insurance claims workflows, provider management, eligibility, adjudication or payment, and healthcare or payer system integrations, including HL7 FHIR and SMART on FHIR where applicable.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Design, business, data, security, DevOps and engineering stakeholders, translating business needs into pragmatic, reliable and measurable technical solutions.

**Competencies & Core Characteristics:**

We are seeking a senior Full Stack AI Engineer who is a strong production software engineer first, with the practical AI delivery experience needed to embed GenAI, RAG, intelligent document processing, evaluation, guardrails and responsible AI capabilities into secure Claims Pro applications and healthcare and insurance workflows.

**Technical Domain Expertise**

Possesses deep full-stack engineering capability across React, TypeScript, Java/Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, cloud-native services, automated testing, CI/CD and production operations, with practical expertise in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, intelligent document processing, evaluation and responsible AI engineering.

**Strategic Architect**

Able to design scalable, secure and maintainable full-stack AI solutions for configurable Claims Pro capabilities aligned with business objectives and regulated-domain requirements. Balances innovation with pragmatic implementation considerations including user experience, API-first design, healthcare and payer interoperability, data architecture, cost, performance, privacy-by-design, auditability, governance, maintainability and operational readiness across customers and markets.

**Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer**

Collaborates effectively across Product, Design, engineering, architecture, data, security, DevOps, operations and business teams. Influences stakeholders through technical credibility, communicates complex full-stack and AI concepts clearly, and helps align solution choices with product value, delivery feasibility and responsible-use controls.

**Data-Driven Decisiveness**

Uses quantitative metrics, experimentation, model and retrieval evaluations, observability signals, production telemetry and operational insights to guide decisions. Continuously measures product quality, AI output reliability, hallucination risk, user adoption, performance and business impact, and drives improvements based on evidence.

**Customer-Obsessed Advocate**

Maintains a strong focus on delivering meaningful customer, user and business impact through Claims Pro. Designs configurable AI-enabled claims experiences and reliable payer and provider integrations that address customer and market requirements, improving productivity, accuracy, decision support, workflow efficiency and value realization while preserving trust, transparency and responsible use.

**Resilient Operator**

Thrives in rapidly evolving technology environments and adapts quickly to changing priorities. Demonstrates end-to-end ownership, accountability and persistence across design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement of complex full-stack and AI-enabled systems.

**Insatiable Curiosity**

Continuously explores emerging full-stack engineering practices, cloud-native services, AI models, RAG patterns, agentic workflows, evaluation techniques and responsible AI controls. Challenges conventional approaches and actively identifies practical opportunities for innovation, automation and competitive advantage.

**Preferred Technical Skills Matrix**

**Must Have**

* Production full-stack software engineering across front end, back end, APIs, data layer and operations
* React, TypeScript, component architecture, routing, state management, forms, schema validation, accessibility and frontend performance
* Nx and Vite workspace development, reusable library boundaries, npm dependency management and modern frontend build practices
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OpenAPI documentation, validation, exception handling and service-layer design
* PostgreSQL, SQL, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, Flyway, schema migrations, transaction management and query optimisation
* OAuth2/OIDC authentication and authorization, Auth0-style patterns, secure API design, secure coding and sensitive-data handling
* Automated testing, code review and quality gates using Jest/Testing Library, JUnit/Spring Boot testing or equivalent tools
* Git, npm, Gradle, CI/CD, release automation, monitoring, logging, observability and production support
* LLM API and enterprise AI service integration, including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or equivalent foundation model platforms
* RAG architecture, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, secure retrieval, retrieval evaluation and enterprise knowledge integration
* AI application integration into user-facing products, dashboards, conversational interfaces, document workflows and operational tools
* Responsible AI, data privacy, application security, auditability, governance, prompt/data handling controls and model-output risk management
* Financial services, insurance, healthcare or other regulated data environment experience

**Good to Have**

* Azure cloud-native services including Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Functions, App Services, Container Apps, Storage and Key Vault
* AWS or GCP cloud-native architecture, managed services, observability, performance engineering and cost-aware production operations
* Docker, Jib, Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms for packaging, deployment and operational readiness
* Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude or other foundation model platforms beyond OpenAI/Azure OpenAI
* LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or equivalent LLM orchestration and agent frameworks
* AI agents, copilots, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems and workflow automation patterns
* OCR, intelligent document processing, extraction/classification pipelines and human-in-the-loop validation workflows
* MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, AI observability, prompt/version management, experimentation and production monitoring practices
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, ontology design and enterprise knowledge management platforms
* Multimodal AI capabilities including vision, speech, translation, video, content moderation and document understanding
* Power Platform AI integration, workflow automation and low-code/no-code enablement for business users
* Domain experience with health insurance, claims, provider management, care management, healthcare analytics or other data-intensive financial products
* HL7 FHIR, SMART on FHIR, healthcare and payer system interoperability, and secure API-first integration patterns
* Bulk data processing and near-real-time integration patterns for healthcare, payer and claims workflows

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: FULL STACK DEVELOPER
description:
TEAM LEAD – BACKEND / FULL STACK ENGINEER (FINTECH)
  
  
**Impacto Digifin Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**
*Bangalore (Brookefield) | Work from Office | Full-Time*
**Job Location**
Bangalore (Brookefield) – Work from Office
  
  
**Experience**
3–5 Years
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department**
Engineering / Product Development
  
  
**Document Date**
21 October 2026
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are hiring a hands-on Team Lead to design, build, and run the backend of our digital banking and payments products. You will lead a small team building Java and Spring Boot microservices, Apache Kafka event pipelines, and PostgreSQL data models that move real money for banks and their customers.
  
  
The role is backend-first, with full stack ownership: you will also guide ReactJS and Next.js frontends that sit on top of these services. You will own the full lifecycle, from requirement analysis and system design to production deployment, monitoring, and 24x7 support.
  
  
We want someone who treats correctness, auditability, and uptime as product features.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Backend and Microservices Development
* Design and build scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and third-party integrations with clear, versioned API contracts.
* Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure coding practices across all services.
* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, backed by unit, integration, and API tests.
* Event-Driven Architecture with Apache Kafka
* Build and maintain event-driven systems using Kafka producers, consumers, and Kafka Streams.
* Design event schemas, topics, partitioning, and retention to match business flows.
* Ensure exactly-once or idempotent processing so no event is lost or applied twice.
* Handle retries, dead-letter topics, consumer lag, and replay for failed or delayed events.
* Apply patterns such as Outbox, Saga, event sourcing, and CQRS where they fit.
* PostgreSQL Data Design and Management
* Design normalized, transactional data models in PostgreSQL for accounts, ledgers, payments, and customers.
* Use ACID transactions, appropriate isolation levels, and row-level locking to keep balances correct under concurrent load.
* Tune queries, indexes, partitioning, and connection pooling for high-volume tables.
* Manage schema changes safely with versioned migrations (Flyway or Liquibase) and zero-downtime deployment.
* Plan data archival, backup, point-in-time recovery, and read replicas for reporting.
* Full Stack Ownership
* Guide and contribute to responsive web applications built with ReactJS, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services and keep API contracts in sync.
* Optimize end-to-end performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
* Team Leadership
* Lead, mentor, and support developers in daily technical work.
* Break business requirements into technical specifications, tasks, and delivery plans.
* Assign work, track progress, and deliver milestones on time.
* Run code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design reviews.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate with Product, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, Business, and Management teams.
* Support technical interviews, onboarding, and knowledge sharing.
* Deployment and Production Support
* Use Git-based workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines for builds and releases.
* Own production health: troubleshoot incidents, fix performance bottlenecks, and lead root-cause analysis.
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures.
* AI-Assisted Development
* Use AI coding tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor for code, tests, debugging, and documentation.
* Review and validate all AI-generated output before it reaches production.

Designing and Maintaining Banking Products
  
  
Designing Banking Products
  
  

* Ledger-first design: build double-entry ledgers in PostgreSQL where every debit has a matching credit and balances can always be rebuilt from entries.
* Transaction integrity: use idempotency keys, unique transaction references, and state machines so a request retried by a customer, bank, or network never posts twice.
* Payment flows: design end-to-end flows for UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, and card or wallet payments, including timeouts, pending states, reversals, and refunds.
* Distributed consistency: keep data consistent across microservices with Outbox, Saga, and compensating transactions instead of distributed locks.
* Core banking integration: integrate with core banking systems such as Oracle FLEXCUBE or Finacle, NPCI and switch interfaces, and partner bank APIs.
* Product configuration: model savings and current accounts, loans, deposits, and wallets so limits, charges, interest, and rules are configuration rather than code changes.
* Customer lifecycle: support onboarding, KYC and e-KYC, account servicing, and closure with clear status tracking.
* Security by design: encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit, mask PII in logs, manage keys through HSM or a vault, and apply least-privilege access.
* Regulatory compliance: build to RBI guidelines, including data localization, audit trails, and NPCI operating rules, and align with PCI DSS where card data is involved.
* Controls: implement maker-checker approvals, transaction limits, velocity checks, and hooks for fraud and AML monitoring.

Maintaining Banking Products in Production
  
  

* Reconciliation: run daily automated reconciliation between internal ledgers, partner banks, NPCI, and settlement files, and resolve mismatches within agreed timelines.
* Settlement and batch jobs: own end-of-day and beginning-of-day processes, interest accrual, charges, and settlement runs, and make them safe to re-run.
* High availability: design for 24x7 uptime with no single point of failure, graceful degradation, and defined RPO and RTO for disaster recovery.
* Observability: track business and technical metrics such as transaction success rate, latency, and consumer lag in Prometheus and Grafana, with alerts before customers notice.
* Incident management: lead incident response, customer-impact assessment, root-cause analysis, and post-incident fixes for failed or stuck transactions.
* Safe change management: release through feature flags, canary or blue-green deployments, and backward-compatible APIs and schemas, with tested rollback plans.
* Audit and reporting: keep immutable audit logs and support regulatory reports, internal audits, and data requests from banks and regulators.
* Continuous improvement: track defects, performance, and technical debt, and plan regular upgrades of frameworks, libraries, and security patches.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**
Candidates must have hands-on experience in the following areas:
  
  

* Backend: strong Java (Core Java, Java 17+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
* Messaging: Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, event design, partitioning, and offset management.
* Database: strong SQL and PostgreSQL, including data modeling, transactions, isolation levels, indexing, and query tuning.
* Architecture: microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, OOP, and design patterns.
* APIs: designing and documenting RESTful APIs with JSON and OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Frontend: working knowledge of ReactJS, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
* DevOps: Docker, Git (GitHub or GitLab), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Testing: unit and integration testing with JUnit and Mockito, plus debugging and code review.
* Leadership: experience guiding developers, reviewing code, planning tasks, and owning delivery.
* Problem solving: strong debugging skills for production issues in distributed systems.

**Mandatory Screening Requirement:**
Candidates must have strong backend experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and PostgreSQL, plus working frontend knowledge in ReactJS or Next.js. Frontend-only profiles will not meet the core requirement.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  

* Payments domain: experience with UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, NPCI integrations, or card and wallet systems is highly preferred.
* Message-driven patterns: event sourcing, CQRS, Saga, and Outbox.
* Performance: experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems, such as payments or UPI switches.
* Spring ecosystem: Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, Spring WebFlux, and Spring Integration.
* Security: OAuth 2.0, JWT, OpenID Connect, encryption, key management, and OWASP practices.
* Data and caching: Redis, PostgreSQL replication and partitioning, and Oracle Database or Oracle FLEXCUBE exposure.
* Cloud and orchestration: Kubernetes, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, and AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Monitoring and quality: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry, and SonarQube.
* Compliance: working knowledge of RBI guidelines, PCI DSS, and audit requirements.
* Ways of working: experience in Agile/Scrum teams.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Banking, Financial Services and FinTech.
* Digital payments, lending, or core banking platforms.
* Enterprise integrations and digital transformation projects.

Skills:- Javascript, React.js, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, TypeScript, SQL, Microservices, Redux/Flux, GitHub, Docker, DevOps, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs, HTML/CSS, Spring Security and NextJs (Next.js)

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack, Frontend-Focused)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack, Frontend-Focused) — Customer Experience Engineering**
Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team.
  
  
Snowflake's Customer Experience Engineering team is expanding. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep frontend craft who enjoys building intelligent data applications that surface insight from diagnostic data and technical content relevant to the issues our customers face. Our Customer Experience engineers build features directly into the Snowflake product that remove the friction points which block customers and drive escalations to Snowflake technical experts. They are energised by the challenge of turning large volumes of structured and unstructured data into interfaces that make the answer obvious.
  
  
In this role you will help build an industry-leading data management system that customers love. You will own the experience layer end to end — interaction design, component architecture, rendering performance, and the data-visualisation surfaces that make complex diagnostics legible — while working comfortably down the stack into the APIs that feed them. You will grow your knowledge of, and contribute to, a robust, highly scalable, and secure enterprise SaaS and Data and AI platform serving thousands of customers and hundreds of millions of complex queries every day. You will build the interfaces that bridge the enterprise world with the consumer experience, working alongside a team of both industry veterans and rising stars.
  
  
**AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:**

* Design and build the user-facing surface of our diagnostic and AI-assisted tooling in React and TypeScript, owning component architecture, state management, and the reusable patterns the team builds on
* Turn dense, high-cardinality diagnostic data into interactive visualisations and workflows that let a customer or an engineer find the cause of an issue in seconds rather than hours
* Own frontend performance and quality — rendering behaviour under large data volumes, bundle and load characteristics, accessibility, and cross-browser correctness
* Work down the stack where the experience demands it, shaping and extending the APIs and services behind your features across Node.js, Java, and SQL
* Collaborate with a cross-functional team spanning product management and design to define product vision and team planning, contributing to interaction and visual decisions rather than receiving them
* Deliver features requiring close coordination with multiple partner teams — pinpointing problems, instrumenting the relevant components, and implementing end-to-end solutions
* Design, build, and contribute to AI-powered features and diagnostic tools, navigating trade-offs around system reliability, tool failure modes, and architectural decisions
* Apply a deliberate personal framework for using AI tools in your daily workflow, knowing precisely when AI accelerates development and when standard engineering approaches are required
* Take full ownership of code quality — catching, debugging, and resolving AI-assisted tool errors before they reach production
* Influence and elevate your team's engineering practices by establishing norms, guides, and review policies around AI-assisted development and code review

**OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* B.E. or M.E. in Computer Science, Electronics and Communication, or an equivalent discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of software engineering experience building modern web applications, with a clear majority of that time spent on frontend work
* Deep expertise in React and TypeScript — component and state architecture, performance profiling and optimisation, and the judgement to know which abstraction a growing codebase actually needs
* Working proficiency in at least one backend area of our stack (Node.js, Java, or SQL), with a track record of shipping features end to end rather than handing off at the API boundary
* Experience building data-dense interfaces — dashboards, tables, charts, or exploratory tooling — and the visualisation libraries and rendering techniques that make them performant at scale
* A strong sense for interaction design and usability, and the ability to partner with designers as a peer
* Experience designing, shipping, or contributing to AI-powered features or LLM-integrated user experiences
* Practical fluency with AI-assisted development tools, backed by a clear framework for tool selection, risk mitigation, and strict quality ownership
* A proven track record of influencing team practices — such as conducting AI code reviews, writing team guides, or updating PR standards following quality learnings
* Mastery of core software engineering best practices: unit and component testing, code reviews, design documentation, and telemetry instrumentation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and genuine enjoyment in building great software alongside a diverse set of peers

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience with design systems or shared component libraries used across multiple teams
* Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG) and building to them by default
* Prior work on developer tools, observability, or diagnostic products

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?
  
  
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: Sr. Software Engineer (Full Stack - Frontend)
description:
Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the
**Enterprise Team**
, you will be a technical leader helping to build the "operating system" of our corporate travel platform. Our team owns the critical infrastructure that allows companies to function globally—managing everything from granular travel policies and dynamic approval workflows to user identity and enterprise-grade analytics.
  
  
This is a high-impact role where you will bridge the gap between complex backend logic and intuitive user experiences. You will collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and designers to build sophisticated configuration tools, real-time dashboards, and seamless integration flows that empower our customers to manage their travel programs at scale.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Architect User Experiences: Drive the frontend architecture for our Admin and User portals. You will build highly responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces that handle complex data sets and configuration flows.
* Build Enterprise-Grade Workflows: Create intuitive, state-heavy UIs for complex business domains—such as configuring dynamic travel policies, visualizing multi-tier approval chains, and managing user roles—while developing the backend API endpoints to support them.
* Collaborate on Design & UX: Partner closely with our Product Design team to implement pixel-perfect interfaces, contribute to our shared UI component libraries, and establish frontend best practices across the engineering organization.
* Develop Supporting Backend Services: Build and evolve the robust Java/Spring Boot backend services, APIs, and data integrations necessary to power your frontend features.
* Own Features End-to-End: Take technical ownership of a problem domain from the user interface down to the database, facilitating the design, development, and launch of key features that directly impact our users.
* Drive the Vision: Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify user pain points, plan the long-term technical roadmap for the frontend architecture, and serve as a subject matter expert on UI/UX engineering.
* Champion Best Practices: Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high-quality code, implementing robust frontend testing strategies (e.g., unit, integration, and E2E testing), mentoring other engineers, and advocating for operational reliability.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in software development, building complex systems for SaaS products or consumer-facing web applications in a fast-paced environment.
* Frontend Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience (4+ years) in frontend development using modern frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue, along with deep proficiency in TypeScript. You should be highly skilled in managing complex application state and optimizing rendering performance.
* Backend Proficiency: Solid experience with backend development using Java and Spring Boot, including hands-on experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), data modeling, and query optimization to support your frontend features.
* Global Mindset: Demonstrated experience with and a strong passion for web accessibility (A11y) and localization (l10n) best practices to serve a diverse, global user base.
* Systems Architecture: Experience designing and implementing scalable applications across microservices, distributed systems, and cloud platforms like AWS.
* Collaborative Ownership: Demonstrates strong ownership and a collaborative mindset, with clear communication skills and a proven ability to ship production-quality code equipped with robust monitoring and documentation.
* AI-Enabled Workflow: Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
