**About the Pod**

A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India-based TechGrove.

**What You Will Do**

* **Deliver full-stack features:**
  Own complex features end to end: backend services, APIs, data, and UI, writing clean, well-tested, production-quality code.
* **Build great frontends:**
  Build responsive, accessible interfaces in React.js and Next.js, implementing against the OpCo’s design system and shared component library for visual and behavioral consistency.
* **Engineer for the cloud:**
  Design and build scalable, secure, resilient applications on cloud-native infrastructure.
* **Design APIs and data:**
  Build robust APIs (REST and GraphQL) and well-designed SQL/No-SQL data models supporting microservices and cloud-native patterns.
* **Develop AI-natively:**
  Use and champion AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code and similar) to maximize velocity and code quality across the SDLC.
* **Own delivery and DevSecOps:**
  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for rapid, reliable, secure deployments.
* **Raise quality through reviews:**
  Participate in and lead code reviews, including of AI-generated code, upholding design patterns (DDD), testing, and application-security standards.
* **Integrate and modernize:**
  Implement integration patterns connecting new services with the OpCo’s existing systems as part of modernization and re-platforming.
* **Own it in production:**
  Take ownership through deployment and operation, contributing to observability, performance, and reliability.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:**
  Strong software engineering experience building production applications.
* **Production experience on AWS or Azure (required):**
  You have built and run production applications on AWS or Azure. Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus.
* **Full-stack ability:**
  Strong proficiency across the stack: modern backend languages and modern UI frameworks (React.js, Next.js, Vite).
* **Modern tech stack:**
  Strong, hands-on experience with at least one of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, or Java.
* **Frontend and design systems:**

* **APIs and data:**
  Hands-on experience designing APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and working with SQL and No-SQL databases.
* **IaC and DevSecOps:**
  Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **AI-native tooling:**
  Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a core part of daily work.
* **Engineering principles:**
  Solid grounding in DDD, clean code, SOLID and DRY, test-driven development, strong typing, and code hygiene.
* **Problem solving:**
  Structured technical problem-solving (decomposition, hypothesis-driven testing) to debug complex issues in distributed systems.
* **Agile and ownership:**
  Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) with a proactive ownership mindset.

**Nice to Have**

* Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).
* Experience developing GenAI capabilities (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen).
* Message queuing and streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Experience with SaaS operating models and observability / APM tooling.
* Experience with application modernization or re-platforming.
* Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS or Azure.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days:**
  You are shipping production features independently, your code sets a clean example for the pod, and you are using agentic tooling fluently in your daily workflow.
* **First 6 months:**
  You are trusted with complex, cross-cutting features, you raise quality through reviews and patterns, and you are a dependable engine of the pod’s delivery.

**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan**

* **Permanent home, long-term thinking:**
  Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:**
  You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* **AI-native by default:**
  You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* **Variety with stability:**
  Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
* **Growth and excellence:**
  A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.

**Should You Apply?**

We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Full Stack Developer Internship (Restaurant OS) — Fully Remote
description:
3 Months
  
  

* Fully Remote
* 32 Hours/Week Preferred
* 2+ Years of Practical Experience

**About ZOVU**
Restaurants have enough to worry about. Their software shouldn't be one of those things.
  
  
At
**ZOVU**
, we're building the Operating System for the modern restaurant. Our vision is simple: one connected platform bringing together Point of Sale, reservations, loyalty, staff operations, and the customer experience.
  
  
And we're doing things differently.
  
  
Instead of charging restaurants expensive monthly subscriptions, our business model is built around transactions.
**When restaurants grow, we grow with them.**
We're an early-stage, fully remote startup preparing for our first restaurant launches. There's already a product in development, a team building it, and plenty of ambitious work ahead.
  
  
If you enjoy creating things that people will actually use, you'll feel at home here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We're looking for an ambitious
**Full Stack Developer Intern**
to help build the applications and systems behind ZOVU.
  
  
This isn't an internship where you'll spend three months watching someone else code.
  
  
You'll contribute to real software, develop new features, improve existing functionality, investigate problems, and work alongside our engineering team to bring ZOVU closer to launch.
  
  
You'll work across both frontend and backend development, turning ideas and product requirements into functional features that restaurant owners, staff, and customers can depend on.
  
  
**We're looking for someone with at least 2 years of practical development experience.**
This can include previous internships, freelance work, professional experience, or substantial personal projects.
  
  
You don't need to be a senior developer, but you should have already built working applications and be comfortable contributing to an existing codebase.
  
  
We're not looking for someone who knows every framework.
**We're looking for someone who knows how to build.**
What Excites You
  
  

* Building Something from the Ground Up: You enjoy turning ideas into working software and watching a product come together.
* Creating Complete Features: You like working on both the interface people interact with and the systems that make it work.
* Solving Real Problems: You enjoy investigating technical challenges, understanding why something doesn't work, and finding better solutions.
* Taking Ownership: You're excited to take responsibility for your work rather than wait for instructions at every step.
* Learning Through Experience: You want to strengthen your skills by contributing to real projects alongside experienced developers.
* Startup Life: You enjoy an environment where ideas matter, priorities evolve, and your contributions make a difference.

What Excites Us
  
  

* 4+ Years of Practical Experience: You have at least two years of hands-on development experience through internships, freelance work, employment, or substantial personal projects, with working applications or meaningful software contributions to demonstrate your experience.
* Frontend Fundamentals: You're comfortable developing web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Backend Fundamentals: You have practical experience with Node.js, APIs, and working with databases.
* Full Stack Development: You've connected frontend interfaces to backend functionality and understand how different parts of an application work together.
* Real Ownership: You can clearly explain what you personally built, the decisions you made, and the challenges you encountered.
* Practical Problem-Solving: You've encountered development problems, investigated their causes, and worked toward functioning solutions.
* Development Practices: You're familiar with Git and GitHub and understand the importance of readable, maintainable code.
* Project Management & Collaboration: You're familiar with tools such as Jira and comfortable using them to manage tasks, track progress, and collaborate with a development team.
* Independence: You can make progress on assigned work, communicate blockers, and ask useful questions when needed.
* Communication: You're comfortable collaborating in English with a remote, international team.

**Bonus points:**
Experience contributing to production applications, business software, SaaS platforms, or products used by real customers.
  
  
We care more about
**what you've actually built**
than a long list of technologies on your CV.
  
  
You don't need advanced engineering knowledge or experience managing a development team. But you should already understand the fundamentals of developing functional applications and be ready to build on that experience.
  
  
Internship Details & Growth
  
  
This is a hands-on internship where you'll develop your full stack engineering skills through practical work, technical guidance, and collaboration with our engineering team.
  
  

* Duration: Three months.
* Location: 100% remote, subject to local internship eligibility requirements.
* Availability: Approximately 32 hours per week preferred.
* Compensation: Unpaid for the three-month internship, where legally permitted under an appropriate internship arrangement.
* Start Date: As soon as possible. You must be able to start within three months of applying.
* Working Style: Primarily asynchronous collaboration, with clear responsibilities and regular communication.
* Potential Paid Opportunity: Strong-performing interns may be considered for a transition into a paid position after the internship, depending on performance, mutual fit, company needs, and available budget. This is a potential opportunity, not a guaranteed employment offer.

The Good Stuff!
  
  

* Real Product Experience: Contribute to an actual software platform preparing for its first restaurant launches.
* End-to-End Development: Gain practical experience building features across frontend and backend systems.
* Meaningful Responsibilities: Work on features that matter, not just practice assignments.
* Direct Access to the Team: Collaborate with developers, exchange ideas, and receive feedback on your work.
* Room to Grow: Strengthen your development skills through real technical challenges and hands-on learning.
* Flexible Remote Work: Take ownership of your schedule and responsibilities while keeping the team informed.
* Your Work Matters: Join at an early stage where individual contributions can have a visible impact.
* International Experience: Work with an international team building a product with global ambitions.
* Potential Career Growth: If there's a strong mutual fit, the internship could be the beginning of a longer-term career with ZOVU.

Life at ZOVU
  
  
We're a remote team connected by one ambition: making restaurant operations simpler through better technology.
  
  
We value people who take initiative, communicate openly, care about their work, and enjoy solving problems together.
  
  
We believe good ideas can come from anyone. You don't need years of corporate experience to make a meaningful contribution.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape how the product develops.
  
  
We encourage independent thinking, but we also believe that asking questions, learning from others, and understanding your own code are essential parts of becoming a great developer.
  
  
You don't need to have every answer. But you should be curious enough to find them.
  
  
**We're building something ambitious, and we'd love to have people on board who are excited to help make it happen.**
How to Apply
  
  
Ready to build something restaurants will depend on?
  
  
We'd love to see what you can bring to ZOVU.
  
  
**Apply through the job posting or send your application to**
**HR@zovuhq.com**
**.**
Please include your CV, GitHub or relevant project examples, and brief answers to these three questions.
  
  
**1. Show us what you've built.**
Share one or two applications or features you've personally developed involving frontend and backend functionality. What did you build, what was your specific contribution, and what does the application actually do?
  
  
Include a GitHub repository, live application, portfolio, or relevant project link whenever possible.
  
  
**2. Tell us about a real challenge.**
Describe a technical problem you personally encountered while developing an application. What was the problem, how did you approach solving it, and what was the result?
  
  
**3. Your experience and availability.**
Briefly describe your practical development experience, including how long you've been building applications.
  
  
Include your earliest start date, weekly availability, time zone, country of residence, and whether you can participate under the stated internship conditions.
  
  
If your previous work is private, you can describe your contribution without sharing confidential information.
  
  
We value
**concrete examples, genuine development experience, and your own words over perfectly polished applications.**
**Let's build something restaurants will depend on.**

  applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio,

  trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

**Position Description**

    We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling the Okta Recovery Vault (ORV). This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability,

  designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

  As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system — spanning backend services and the admin-facing UI that customers

  use to review and restore their data. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—while also crafting

  intuitive, performant workflows that let admins confidently recover from data loss events.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

  -
**Feature**
**Execution:**
Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers — from backend APIs to the admin console UI.

  -
**Component Design:**
Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events, support scalable data restoration, and surface clear, actionable recovery status to end users.

  -
**UI/UX for Recovery Workflows:**
Build responsive, accessible front-end experiences (e.g., recovery dashboards, bulk restore flows, audit views) that make complex backend recovery operations easy for admins to understand and act on.

  -
**Relationship & State Management:**
Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency, and reflect that state accurately in the UI.

  -
**Security & Compliance:**
Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.

  -
**Product & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones across the stack.

  -
**Operational Excellence:**
Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues (backend and frontend), perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.

  -
**Code Quality & Technical Standards:**
Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing (unit, integration, and UI), and comprehensive technical documentation.

  -
**Team Growth:**
Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality across the full stack.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

  -
**Experience:**
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade full stack applications.

  -
**Backend**
**Expertise:**
Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in Java and the Spring Boot framework.

  -
**Frontend Expertise:**
Solid experience building modern, component-based web UIs (e.g., React, TypeScript) including state management, performance optimization, and accessibility best practices.

  -
**Distributed Systems:**
Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).

  -
**Data Management:**
Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., MySQL) and caching strategies (e.g., Redis) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.

  -
**API Design:**
Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust RESTful APIs, and consuming them to build seamless, responsive front-end experiences.

  -
**Problem Solving & Ownership:**
Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs across the entire stack.

**Nice to Haves**

  - Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).

  - Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).

  - Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.

  - Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

  - Experience with design systems / component libraries and cross-browser/responsive UI testing.

**Education and Training**

  B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Fullstack Developer - Director - Software Engineering**
**Profile Description**

In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. This is Director position that develops and maintains software solutions that support business needs.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Collaborates with Systems Architects, Software Team Leads and other Software Developers
* to design, develop and deploy technical solutions.
* Analyses complex information, designs, develops and troubleshoots database applications
* Reviews functional requirements and prepares and documents technical program, subsystem and
* system designs and solutions and their associated project task descriptions and effort estimates
* Uses both industry-standards and company's existing systems architecture, design techniques and
* development standards and reviews new work with others to ensure it complies with industry and
* company standards.
* Documents technical requirements, program and subsystem designs, project task descriptions,
* effort estimates, and unit and integration tests
* Performs new development, maintenance fixes and enhancements to meet business requirements
* Assists other teams to troubleshoot application issues in production, quality assurance and other
* environments
* Develops, reviews, refines, uses and documents plans for both automated and manual unit and
* integration tests and/or assures unit and integration tests are successfully completed prior to
* production
* Tests programs for integration prior to production
* Mentors other software developers and IT staff members
* Documents resolutions to system problems
* Documents design for system requirements

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* At least 8+ years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role with Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field
* Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Advanced Java Concepts and Oracle
* Proficiency in UNIX/Linux and Microsoft Windows distributed computing
* Product Analysts, QA, UAT, Development and PMO members
* Ability to juggle tasks and priorities to meet rapidly changing deadlines
* Must work with System Architects to review/approve program and subsystem designs
* React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS (Bootstrap/Tailwind), Responsive Design
* Data Structures & Algorithms, API/API Design
* Java IDE (preferably IntelliJ IDEA)
* JDBC and JPA/Hibernate
* Relational DB principles using Structured Query Language (SQL)
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills in working in a cross-functional team

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Full Stack Lead
description:
Job description

Full Stack Lead / Solution Architect (Angular/React with Python & Azure Services)

**Experience:**
12-16 Years

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid (Monday Work From Home, Tuesday-Friday Work From Office)

**Shift Timing:**
1:30 PM - 10:30 PM

Job Location: Bangalore(Bellandur)

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Full Stack Lead / Solution Architect**
with deep expertise in
**modern web technologies, Python-based backend development, cloud-native architecture, and Microsoft Azure services**
. The ideal candidate will drive end-to-end solution architecture, lead engineering teams, mentor developers, and deliver scalable enterprise-grade applications using
**Angular or React, Python, and Azure Cloud Services**
.

This role requires strong hands-on technical leadership, architecture ownership, stakeholder management, and a passion for modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and cloud-native application design.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

* Provide technical leadership across full-stack engineering teams.
* Mentor developers and establish engineering best practices.
* Lead architecture discussions, solution reviews, and code quality initiatives.
* Drive technical excellence through design reviews, code reviews, and engineering standards.

Architecture & Solution Design

* Design scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native enterprise solutions.
* Own end-to-end application, integration, and platform architecture.
* Define technology roadmaps and modernization strategies.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs and recommend optimal architectural decisions.

Full Stack Development

* Architect and develop modern web applications using Angular or React.
* Build robust backend services, APIs, and microservices using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Design and implement reusable components, service layers, and integration patterns.
* Ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture practices.

Cloud & Azure Engineering

* Design and build cloud-native solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure services.
* Implement scalable architectures using Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure Service Bus, Azure SQL, and related PaaS offerings.
* Drive cloud security, governance, monitoring, and observability initiatives.
* Lead CI/CD automation and DevOps adoption using Azure DevOps and GitHub.

Frontend Engineering & User Experience

* Build responsive, accessible, and high-performance user interfaces using Angular or React.
* Collaborate with UX teams to deliver intuitive and engaging user experiences.
* Establish frontend architecture, component standards, and reusable design systems.

Agile Delivery & Collaboration

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, and Engineering teams.
* Lead technical planning, estimation, backlog refinement, and sprint delivery activities.
* Support Agile delivery processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt effectively.

AI & Modern Engineering Practices

* Champion AI-assisted development using GitHub Copilot and other approved tools.
* Drive adoption of automation, observability, DevSecOps, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions.

. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.

* Collaborate with architects, developers, QA, product managers and support teams, and take part in code reviews and technical design discussions

You do not need to match every line below. If most of it describes you, apply:
  
  

* 3-7 years of full-stack software development experience, with strong programming and object-oriented design fundamentals
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and debugging skills, and the ability to learn quickly in unfamiliar codebases and technology stacks
* Hands-on backend experience in .NET/C#, Java or a similar enterprise stack, including REST APIs and ORM frameworks. Prior .NET experience is a plus, not a requirement
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript with a modern front-end framework. Vue is preferred; React or Angular experience is welcome if you can transition to Vue quickly

**Benefits**

* Flexible work environment

Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!

title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
description:
**Location:**
100% Remote
  
  
**Employment:**
Full-time, long-term position
  
  
**Start date:**
As soon as possible after selection and agreement
  
  
**Salary:**
Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years
  
  
**About Us**
We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
  
  
Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.
  
  
AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.
  
  
You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.
  
  
Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.
  
  
This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
* Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
* Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
* Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
* Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
* Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
* Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
* Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
* Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
* Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
* Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
* Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
* Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
* Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
* Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
* A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
* Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
* Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
* Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
* Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
* Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
* The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
* Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
* Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
* Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
* Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
* Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

**Growth, Responsibility And Compensation**
Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.
  
  
Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.
  
  
For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
* The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
* Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
* Close collaboration with startup leadership.
* The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

**Remote Working Arrangement**
Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.
  
  
Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.
  
  
**How To Apply**
We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.
  
  
Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:
  
  

* A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
* An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
* Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
* A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
* Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

title: Software Engineer I - Product / Full-Stack
description:
**Location:**
Jayanagar, Bengaluru — in office
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
0–1 years; strong fresh graduates and builders are welcome
  
  
**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
The role
  
  
You will build product features end to end across our Flutter app, web surfaces, backend APIs, and data. We do not need you to know every part on day one. We need evidence that you learn quickly, finish what you start, care about the user experience, and understand the code you ship.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Build and ship small product features across app/web, API, and data layers.
* Turn product/design intent into complete user flows, including loading, empty, error, and retry states.
* Debug issues across client, network, backend, and data—not stop at the first layer.
* Write tests, review your own diff, and verify behavior before handoff.
* Read user feedback and product metrics to understand whether a release worked.
* Use AI coding tools to move faster while remaining responsible for every line you ship.
* Ask precise questions, communicate blockers early, and learn from direct feedback.

What we are looking for
  
  

* You have built and shipped at least one real software project, internship deliverable, freelance product, or meaningful open-source contribution.
* You can write readable code and reason through bugs without blindly relying on autocomplete or AI.
* You have worked across at least two layers: mobile/web, backend/API, database, or deployment.
* You care about product details and notice when a technically correct feature creates a bad user experience.
* You move quickly, but you test your work and own mistakes.
* You can explain your contribution, trade-offs, and what you would improve next.
* You are comfortable working in person in Jayanagar, Bengaluru. A computer-science degree is not required. Evidence of building matters more than credentials.

Useful, not mandatory
  
  

* Flutter/Dart and mobile fundamentals.
* State management such as BLoC or Riverpod.
* REST APIs, SQL, caching, queues, or real-time systems.

title: Fullstack Engineer (.NET & React)
description:
TechGrove is the
**Centre of Excellence**
for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

About Berkeley Myles
  
We build software for UK manufacturers who can't afford to get things wrong: aerospace, medical
  
devices, oil and gas, motorsport. Our product, ProgressPlus, runs the whole job from first enquiry
  
through to final invoice. Hundreds of manufacturers run on it every day, and when one of them has to
  
prove what went into a part, it's where the answer comes from. We're now building a new product with
  
AI on every stage of that flow.
  
We're part of Banyan Software, the best permanent home for software businesses that serve
  
specialised industries, their employees, and their customers. Banyan is a Great Place to Work Certified
  
company, a five-time Inc. 5000 honoree, and a top-10 company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500.
  
Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Banyan operates more than 100 portfolio companies
  
across North America, the UK, the EU, and APAC.
  
About the Role
  
ProgressPlus has been running factories since 1999. Every rule inside it is a decision someone once
  
made about how a manufacturer works: when a quote becomes an order, what commits stock, what
  
has to be true before a part can ship. Hundreds of businesses have built their working day on those
  
decisions.
  
We're building the replacement. Feature by feature, that means understanding why each of those rules
  
exists, building what the product manager decides it should become on a cloud platform with AI on
  
every stage, and speaking up when what you find in the old system changes the answer.
  
You'll work across the whole flow: enquiry, quote, order, jobs, scheduling, tracking, quality, shipping,
  
invoice. One month that's purchasing, the next it's shop-floor tracking, and each feature runs from the
  
data model through the .NET service to the part a planner or an inspector uses all day. The features
  
that matter most span several stages, because a change to an order ripples through jobs, stock and
  
invoicing, and the customer expects all of it to agree. That's why every engineer here works across the
  
whole flow.
  
The platform is built and running: five .NET services on Azure with architecture boundaries enforced in
  
CI, a database per customer company, and a Next.js frontend. A platform engineer owns that estate and
  
the path to production. An AI engineer owns the agent layer. You build the product on top of both, and

canvas

once the agent layer exists, you'll be among the first to put AI into the flow. The team you'd join is small:
  
five engineers and a lead.
  
We build with AI coding agents, wired into our issue tracking and version control. The repo already
  
holds what they need: project instructions, coding rules per area, specialised agents for tests,
  
documentation and architecture review, and a learnings log the team maintains. You'll direct the agents,
  
review what they produce, and answer for everything you merge.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
The kind of work on the board: an operator books on and off a job from a tablet on the shop floor and
  
the planner's schedule moves before they refresh. A delivery arrives against a purchase order, gets
  
allocated to the jobs waiting on it, and leaves behind the certificate an aerospace customer will ask for a
  
year later. A quantity changes on a sales order and the works orders, material demand and invoice
  
downstream all agree with it. A stock grid holds every part a customer owns, with filters that compile to
  
SQL and stay fast. And, once the agent layer lands, the first AI on a stage: an agent that drafts a job's
  
audit pack from its real records, with a person approving every page.
  
Building the product
  
Take features end to end across any stage of the flow, from the data model to what the user touches,
  
with tests at each layer
  
Get the cross-stage behaviour right: when an order, a job and an invoice have to agree, make sure
  
they do
  
Get authorisation and validation right on every feature, and never be the reason data crosses
  
between customers
  
Write schema changes as migrations that run safely across every customer's database
  
Keep it fast at real volumes: a customer's full parts list, years of jobs, and a shop floor writing to it all
  
day. Instrument it so we can see when it isn't
  
Prototype when you see a better way. The product manager leads the design and there is no
  
designer in between, so engineers build prototypes against the product's patterns and bring them to
  
the product manager
  
Build the integrations customers depend on: APIs for the systems that read from ProgressPlus,
  
connectors into the ones it reads from, and versioning so neither breaks when we change something
  
Working with agents
  
Direct coding agents on production work: break work into tasks they can execute reliably, supervise
  
them to a merged and tested result, and intervene when their output is wrong. You know which work
  
to hand an agent and which to do yourself
  
Maintain the agent context: project instructions, per-area rules, reusable skills, and the learnings log,
  
so the next person or agent working in that area starts from what you learned
  
The team and the customer
  
Review others' work across the flow with the same rigour as your own, and take review from them
  
the same way

canvas

Take your turn on the application team's support rota: triage what comes in, fix what's yours, and
  
write up anything that should never happen twice
  
Spend time with the people who use the product, customers and our own support team, and turn
  
what you learn into what gets built
  
Support UAT and resolve defects before and after release, and build the features customers need
  
before they can move off the legacy product
  
How We Work
  
Linear as the single board: work traced from issue to acceptance criteria to PR, reporting as a by-
  
product of the work
  
A small team: full stack engineers with a lead, plus AI and platform specialists, on a .NET and Next.js
  
platform on Azure
  
Prototype-led: we design the flow before we build it, against a shared design system
  
AI in daily use across the team: coding agents in the repo with the context they need, and AI tooling
  
for research, prototyping and analysis
  
A customer base we can pick up the phone to, and an implementation team on their sites every week
  
Tech Stack You'll Use
  
Backend: C#, .NET 10, Rebus messaging, SQL Server (database per company), EF Core
  
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TanStack Table, Tailwind
  
Testing: xUnit, Vitest and Testing Library, Playwright
  
Cloud: Azure (Container Apps, Azure SQL, Service Bus), GitHub Actions
  
Tooling: Claude Code, Linear, GitHub
  
What We're Looking For
  
5+ years building customer-facing web products across the full stack, and a track record of driving
  
complex, end-to-end features, not incremental improvements, with visible impact on the product
  
Hands-on experience directing agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents or
  
equivalent) on production code. You can walk us through specific work you shipped this way, how
  
you structured it, and where you had to step in
  
Deep enough in C# / .NET and TypeScript / React to know when the code is wrong, whoever wrote it
  
Solid relational database skills: you can design a schema within an existing model, write a migration
  
you'd run against live data, and find the slow query
  
You treat tests as part of the definition of done, and you can prove a test works by breaking it on
  
purpose
  
Product sensibility: you care about UX, speed and polish, you'd rather ask the person using it for
  
eight hours a day than guess, and you push back when something doesn't feel right

canvas

High ownership: a self-directed, full-lifecycle builder who takes a feature from a conversation with a
  
user to production, and helps shape the problem rather than waiting for a spec
  
Comfortable in a large product you didn't build: you read before you write, you find the existing
  
pattern before inventing one, and you know when to ask for a second opinion
  
You can explain a technical decision and its trade-offs to someone who doesn't write code, and
  
change your mind when they're right
  
Strong written communication: you'll work with a team split across time zones
  
This isn't the role if you want a finished spec before you start, if you'd rather stay on one side of the
  
stack, if you see coding agents as either a threat or a toy, or if a product with twenty-five years of
  
customers behind it sounds like baggage rather than material.
  
Preferred Experience
  
Manufacturing, ERP, MRP or supply chain systems, or genuine curiosity about how factories run
  
Multi-tenant SaaS, especially database-per-tenant
  
Azure services and cloud-hosted applications
  
Building product features on top of an internal agent or tool layer
  
Authoring agent skills, prompt libraries or project instructions that other engineers relied on
  
Accessibility (WCAG) and offline-first or PWA work for the shop floor
  
Replacing a system people already depend on, where "how it works today" is both the spec and the
  
problem
  
What We Offer
  
A team that builds with agents as standard, and a repo that already carries the context they need
  
What you ship goes into factories that can't run without it
  
The backing of Banyan Software, a permanent home for software businesses, with the pace of a
  
small product team
  
Pension, holiday entitlement, remote working and a learning budget
  
A direct line into product and architecture decisions

***Recruitment Notice***

TechGrove may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

***Beware of Recruitment Scams***

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.

**Protect yourself by following these steps:**

* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
  **@banyansoftware.com**
  email address.
* Remember, employers will
  **never**
  request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
  **do not respond**
  — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

description:

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

We are looking for a Lead Full Stack Engineer to own and evolve the core architecture of the company across both the frontend and backend, and to set the technical bar for how the rest of the engineering team builds full-stack features.

You will work directly with the founders on systems that orchestrate real operational workflows across emails, documents, humans, databases, and ERP systems. A crucial part of this role is bridging our AI infrastructure with user experience - you will build the next-generation interfaces where human operators collaborate with our Systems of Action, and make the architectural calls that other engineers will build on top of. The work sits at the intersection of full-stack engineering, workflow orchestration, UI/UX architecture, and AI infrastructure.

This is not a feature-factory role. We want someone who can hold large parts of the system in their head, make strong architectural decisions across the stack, and raise the quality bar for the team.

* Work closely with product and forward-deployed engineering teams to translate real customer problems into cohesive end-to-end features.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals and production experience owning end-to-end feature delivery.
* Deep experience with React and modern frontend ecosystems, coupled with a strong eye for user experience and interface design.
* Deep experience with Python and distributed / backend systems.
* A strong ownership mentality and systems thinking - you care just as much about UI state management as you do about backend database query optimization.
* Ability to design reliable, observable, maintainable systems.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
* Clear communication and sound engineering judgment.
* Excitement about AI-native software development and agentic systems.

Join GeneralMind as a Lead Full Stack Engineer! Drive innovation in AI, transform enterprise workflows, and grow with us. Be part of a team shaping the future of business automation!

We're looking for a hands-on full-stack engineer who has built and operated real-time communication systems at scale. You'll work on WebRTC, video conferencing, and streaming infrastructure, and you'll own the health of those systems end to end. Building the system is only half the job. We expect you to know whether it is actually working, using telemetry, metrics, traces, browser waterfalls, WebRTC statistics, and network behavior. "The deployment succeeded" isn't proof that the system is fine. The data is. You will also work on agentic and AI-powered platforms, using AI as a force multiplier across engineering, debugging, and product problem-solving.

* Strong experience building full-stack applications. Minimum 4 years

* Hands-on experience building or operating WebRTC/video conferencing systems, including
* WebRTC providers or platforms at meaningful scale.
* Strong understanding of WebRTC and real-time media: simulcast, adaptive bitrate, codecs,
* RTP/RTCP, ICE, STUN/TURN, and related concepts.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience with production telemetry, monitoring, and observability.
* Ability to analyze browser waterfalls and network behavior.
* Experience with distributed systems and production infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of AI development tools and workflows.

* Experience building agentic platforms or AI-powered products.
* Experience with large-scale conferencing platforms or thousands of concurrent real-time
* connections.

* Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar observability tooling.
* Experience building real-time dashboards and monitoring systems.
* Experience with media quality analytics and WebRTC QoS.
* Experience with Kubernetes and AWS.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Work on agentic and AI platforms**

* Build applications where AI agents interact with users, tools, APIs, and business systems.
* Understand agent workflows, tool calling, state management, and orchestration.
* Build reliable systems around LLMs and agents, with attention to latency, reliability,
* observability, and cost.
* Evaluate and monitor AI-powered workflows.
* Use AI aggressively as a development multiplier. You should ask "Can AI do this for me?" before

* management, API integration, and modern web architecture. Debug issues at the frontend,
* browser, and network levels.
* Backend: Design and build APIs and backend services in Node.js. Work with asynchronous and
* distributed systems, MySQL and database design, caching, queues, and event-driven
* architecture.
* Infrastructure: Understand cloud infrastructure, containers, deployment, scaling, and
* observability, and debug across application, infrastructure, and network layers.

**About GreyLabs AI**

GreyLabs AI is building the voice operating system for India's BFSI. Our Agentic Voice AI platform helps banks, insurers, NBFCs, and fintechs automate and humanise millions of customer conversations - across sales, collections, customer service, and compliance - in multiple Indian languages.

In under two years, we've scaled to 50+ enterprise clients, including RBL Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential Life, Motilal Oswal - processing hundreds of millions of conversations. We raised ₹85 Crores in Series A funding led by Elevation Capital with Z47, and were recognised for "Best Use of AI in Fintech" at IFTA 2025.

SDE3 at GreyLabs means owning technical bets end-to-end: writing the design doc, making the architecture call, and shipping it. You’ll work across
**Voice AI Agents**
(our flagship autonomous voice platform) and
**Voice Analytics**
(Conversation Intelligence for CXOs).

**What You’ll Do**

* Own complex engineering problems end-to-end - from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and production operations, including personally driving resolution of production incidents.
* Write technical design documents, lead design reviews, and make architecture calls.
* Identify and resolve cross-cutting technical challenges: latency, reliability, security, and scalability across the platform.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Haves**

* 5-8 years of engineering experience; track record of owning and shipping complex systems
* Deep backend expertise: designed and operated distributed systems in production; familiar with failure modes at scale.
* Strong Python (Django) and Golang for production systems - idiomatic, performant code;
* Solid experience with React.js and modern frontend development
* Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, or equivalents)
* Strong fundamentals in relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), data modelling, and query optimisation
* Led technical design: wrote design docs, ran design reviews, and owned architecture decisions cross-functionally.
* An appetite for learning and figuring things out - at a growing startup in an emerging category, the problems are often new and the playbook is still being written

**Strong Signals**

* Voice AI stack in production: Deepgram, Whisper, AWS Transcribe, ElevenLabs, Google TTS, or equivalent ASR/TTS tools.
* LLM orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom) in a production voice or conversational AI system.
* Streaming or event-driven architectures
* BFSI-adjacent domain experience - compliance monitoring, audit trails, and data sensitivity requirements in practice.

**Why GreyLabs AI**

* **A hard problem in a large market.**
  Building low-latency, multilingual Voice AI for regulated financial institutions - across diverse Indian languages and under RBI and IRDAI compliance requirements - is technically complex and commercially consequential.
* **Real scale, real engineering challenges.**
  The reliability, cost, and infrastructure challenges here reflect actual production load.
* **Scope to shape the technical direction.**
  At our current stage, architectural decisions move quickly from design to production. Senior engineers have direct influence on how the platform is built and what it becomes.
* **Strong backing, proven team.**
  Elevation Capital and Z47 are long-term partners invested in our vision. Our founders built and exited Cogno AI - they understand what it takes to build AI companies that earn enterprise trust.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Vocera, now part of Stryker, is seeking an experienced Staff Engineer (
**Full Stack Software Engineer)**
to develop and maintain enterprise analytics capabilities for healthcare communications data. This role works across
**Angular applications, Java services and REST APIs, relational databases, and data-processing workflows**
supporting dashboards, reporting, and operational monitoring.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and develop full-stack features for analytics dashboards, scheduled reports, data exports, and operational monitoring using Angular, Java, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Build and maintain Angular user interfaces for data visualization, filtering, reporting, exports, and administrative workflows.
* Develop Java backend services and REST APIs that query analytics data and support dashboard and reporting requirements.
* Design and optimize relational database solutions using complex SQL, schema design, indexing, stored procedures, and query-performance tuning for large datasets.
* Develop and maintain data-processing workflows that transform healthcare communications data, including calls, messages, badge activity, and alarms, into structured analytics data.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across user interfaces, backend services, databases, and data pipelines, including production and on-premises deployments.
* Apply secure coding, automated testing, resilient error handling, performance optimization, and privacy requirements appropriate for enterprise healthcare software.
* Own features through design, development, code review, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support while collaborating with Engineering, Product, Quality, DevOps, and Program Management.

**Required Qualifications**
**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 -9 years of software development experience.
* Experience developing full-stack applications using Angular and Java.
* Experience with relational databases, including complex SQL, schema design, indexing, stored procedures, and query optimization, with MariaDB or MySQL experience.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and developing data-rich web applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or another cloud platform.
* Experience developing analytics, reporting, ETL, batch-processing, or data warehouse solutions, including dimensional or warehouse-style data models.
* Experience with one or more of the following: MariaDB production environments, Scala, Play Framework, Apache Spark, AngularJS, enterprise reporting tools, LDAP, SAML, Prometheus, Grafana, CI/CD, or automated testing.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

description:

Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
  
  
We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:
  
  

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Overview**
As a Senior Developer you will expect to immediately lead the delivery of capabilities in a growing and dynamic technology team. You will be expected to be a technical leader in the team, and mentor junior developers in their developer journey. Some people management may be required.
  
  
Working in a fully Agile Scrum/Kanban team, you will be exposed to a diverse range of technologies and like-minded people, all with the same mission – to ensure Aon remains the #1 data-driven broker in the world.
  
  
This role requires a mix of hands-on technical expertise, leadership, and stakeholder management, ensuring the successful delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.
  
  
The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in object-oriented programming, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, cloud technologies (Azure), and SQL databases. They should be proactive, self-motivated, and capable of mentoring team members while collaborating effectively with international clients and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Building and maintaining Single Page Applications (SPAs), using technologies such as Typescript, React, and D3.js.
* Using C# to build API’s both for specific application use, and more general use across the application estate.
* Contributing to design, build, test & maintenance activities and be genuinely motivated by delivering solutions and issue resolutions to our business
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines as code
* Promote and adhere to development standards through automation tooling and manual controls incl. JIRA, agile standards, code reviews and release automation, etc
* Work with Product Owners, Scrum Masters and Business Analysts on the vision, design, requirements, and delivery of web-based analytics applications
* Develop a thorough understanding of the functional and non-functional requirements of the application, how customers use it, and how best to serve these needs
* Ensure effective operation of business systems through Level 3 support of application incidents, effectively triaging bugs, code/data fixes, testing & patching processes
* Welcome the opportunity to assist and spread knowledge to other members of the team
* Support QA in testing products and resolving found issues
* Deliver and maintain solution/process documentation to an agreed level
* Track and report on progress to IT Development Manager, Product Owners & Scrum Masters

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/computer science with 8+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years of leading and mentoring development teams.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in development; C#, Advanced JavaScript (preferably React)
* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent experience
* Keenly interested in software development, staying up to date with current trends and able to translate those into solutions
* Experience with Cloud (AWS), Serverless Architecture, Agile, DevOps (CI/CD) and database technologies
* Someone with good interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable and composed
* Experience working in Agile environments
* Working in a high-pressure environment
* UI/UX experience a plus
* Exposure to code quality and observability tools like SonarQube and Application Insights.
* Strong leadership in Agile/Scrum methodologies – sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, conducting code reviews, and enforcing coding standards.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Willingness to work in UK shift hours for effective collaboration with global teams and clients.

**Desired Skills**

* Azure Developer Associate certification.
* Azure Solution Architect certification.
* Agile certifications such as CSM (Certified ScrumMaster) or PSM (Professional Scrum Master).

**Additional Information**
**Why Version 1?**
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
  
  
Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

title: Cloud & Infrastructure Expert Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Our
**Consulting**
team at BearingPoint is dedicated to optimizing client business operations through advanced ERP and CRM systems. With deep expertise in SAP across various domains like finance, logistics, data, and technology, we streamline processes and enhance decision-making efficiency. Our proficiency in Salesforce helps us improve customer relationships with innovative strategies. We leverage data tools like PowerBI for insightful analytics and excel in Microsoft cloud technologies, particularly Azure, to provide secure and scalable solutions. Additionally, our team develops integrated mobile front-end and back-end applications, ensuring user-friendly mobile access to ERP and CRM systems.
  
  
BearingPoint's consulting services are designed to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client, driving growth and operational excellence. We pride ourselves on our client-centric approach, focusing on delivering measurable results and sustainable improvements.
  
  
As an Expert Fullstack Engineer focused on infrastructure, you will be a hands-on technical lead. You will design, build and run secure, scalable and resilient Generative AI solutions, including BeMind, BearingPoint's enterprise AI platform, from the application down to the cloud infrastructure. About half of your time goes to infrastructure, security and DevOps. The other half goes to backend and full-stack engineering.
  
  
**Primary Functions and Tasks:**

* Architecture & infrastructure: design and build enterprise-grade cloud solutions, with Azure as the focus, that are highly available, secure, cost-efficient and compliant.
* Networking, security & identity: own network design, security and identity and access management (RBAC, MFA, least privilege), and set best practices for the team.
* DevOps & automation: evolve CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and automation of cloud resources, and make releases routine and low-risk.
* Containers & services: containerise applications, evolve architecture from monoliths towards services, and choose the right compute model (App Services, serverless, VMs, Kubernetes).
* AI infrastructure & APIs: run AI services such as Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry and AI Search, and expose, secure and govern APIs, including through API Management and as MCP servers.
* Full-stack engineering: build robust backend APIs and contribute to the frontend where platform knowledge is critical.
* Reliability: set up monitoring, logging and alerting, and drive performance and cost optimisation.
* Leadership: mentor colleagues, set architecture standards and explain complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We are looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (Master's degree or further cloud training is a plus), or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 8+ years of professional IT experience, including several years building
* and running production cloud infrastructure and doing backend / full-stack development.
* Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud. Azure is ideal; strong AWS or
* GCP experience is welcome if you are willing to become proficient in Azure quickly.
* Solid cloud networking and security fundamentals: virtual networks, firewalls / NSGs, load balancing, DNS, TLS, identity and access management.
* Infrastructure as code in production (Terraform, Bicep / ARM, Pulumi, CloudFormation or similar).
* Designing CI/CD pipelines in any mainstream tool (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab
* CI, Jenkins …) and container-based deployments with Docker.
* Strong backend skills in at least one language: TypeScript / Node.js is ideal; Python, C# /
* .NET, Java or Go are welcome. You can also work on the frontend.
* Strong relational database skills, including design and performance tuning. PostgreSQL is preferred.
* Proven experience troubleshooting complex systems and improving reliability in production.
* A track record of delivering enterprise projects from concept to production and of leading teams technically.

Nice to have:
  
  

* Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search or other LLM services in production.
* Azure API Management (policies, authentication mechanisms) and exposing APIs as MCP servers.
* Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Serverless architectures (Azure Functions, AWS Lambda or similar).
* Leading monolith-to-microservices migrations or cloud transformations.
* Azure Monitor / Log Analytics or comparable observability tooling.
* Consulting or client-facing project experience.
* Certifications such as AZ-305, AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-500 or AWS / GCP equivalents. A plus, not a requirement.

**What we offer:**

* Learning-oriented organization with a people development focus
* Attractive compensation package:
* Fixed salary compensation along with Yearly Evaluation and performance-related bonus scheme
* Benefits buffet
* Extended annual leave
* Complete training & certification curricula available
* E-Learning System

**For more information, please visit:**
www.linkedin.com/company/bearingpoint
  
  
**About BearingPoint**
BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. Consulting covers the advisory business with a clear focus on selected business areas. Products provides IP-driven digital assets and managed services for business-critical processes. Capital delivers M&A and transaction services.
  
  
BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and supports clients in over 70 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.
  
  
*BearingPoint is a certified B Corporation, meeting*
high standards of social and environmental impact.
  
  
*In India, BearingPoint currently*
operates with one office situated in Bengaluru. We work closely with all BearingPoint entities and offer technology and management consulting services with a human touch to both local and international top clients. We also enable our Products unit with development and Platform services SAP.
  
  
*Our team in India allows us to*
leverage work with clients who have extensive operations and affiliations in various European countries, in the US, and across Asia.
  
  
*Together with our colleagues from Romania, the Czech Republic, and Portugal, we are part of BearingPoint’s Cross-Shore Enablement Hub (CSH) which offers a wide range of Consulting and Products*
expertise.

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.
