* Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time.
* A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer — Platform Services & Reporting UI
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building AssureDroid , an autonomous AI-driven platform that validates Android applications across the OS ecosystem. As Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will own the layer that connects intelligence to humans — the Control Plane services that orchestrate every test run, the multi-database storage layer (Postgres + FAISS + Neo4j + GCS + BigQuery), AND the live execution dashboard plus reporting UI where engineers and Google leadership consume the results.
  
  
This role is for engineers who care equally about clean backend abstractions and information-dense, high-clarity UI. You will design API contracts that the dashboard, CI/CD triggers, and webhooks consume — then build the Streamlit live dashboard and React-based reports that turn raw run data into decisions. Every demo to Google leadership flows through systems you own end-to-end.
  
  
This is a high-leverage role with a wide surface area. We’re hiring for the engineer who can design the schema in the morning, ship the API by afternoon, and polish the dashboard panel that consumes it before EOD.
  
  
**Role Expectation**
Backend & Platform Services
  
  
Design and implement the agent message contracts (Protobuf/Pub/Sub schemas) connecting Control Plane to Data Plane
  
  
Build the Postgres relational schema (apps, scenarios, runs, decisions, validations)
  
  
Develop the artifact pipeline to Cloud Storage with PII scrubbing pre-persistence
  
  
Implement the decision trace logger — append-only, immutable, indexed by run\_id
  
  
Build the Replay Engine that reconstructs any past run with deterministic guarantees
  
  
Develop REST/gRPC APIs that the dashboard, CI/CD triggers, and webhooks consume
  
  
Integrate BigQuery analytics ETL for KPIs, cost telemetry, regression trends
  
  
Own the Module Registry — JSON manifest, activation toggles, versioning strategy
  
  
**Frontend & Reporting UI**

title: AI-Native Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Apra Labs

Apra Labs is a ~60-person engineering company in Derry (NH, USA), Bengaluru and Dubai, founded by engineers with 100+ person-years across computer vision, embedded systems, biometrics and cloud. We build our own products (ApraPipes, our open-source video framework; AVMS, our video management platform; and apra-fleet, our open-source multi-agent orchestration platform) and run engineering programs for enterprise and mission-driven customers across several industries.

We are AI-native. Agents write most of our first drafts, and AI runs inside what we ship.

The Role

Full Stack Engineer – AI-Native. Full time, on-site in Bengaluru, 3–7 years of experience. You own features end to end on one of three tracks:

- Web apps – Cloud-backed business applications: workflow automation, data extraction, AI-assisted review, dashboards

- Mobile apps – Cross-platform field apps with offline sync, on-device and cloud AI

- Video pipelines, streaming and video AI – Edge-to-cloud video on NVIDIA Jetson and DGX Spark: capture, low-latency streaming (RTSP, WebRTC, HLS), video AI and analytics (detection, tracking, search, VLM event understanding), device fleets, playback

The bar is the same on every track: you build with AI, and you ship AI.

What You'll Do

- Build end to end: TypeScript/React web or cross-platform mobile front ends, C/C++, C#/.NET or Python services and APIs, SQL and NoSQL data.

- Direct coding agents (Claude Code, apra-fleet) as your default way of working. You write the spec, tests and agent instructions; you review and own every line.

- Ship LLM features in production (extraction, summarization, classification, search, video understanding, copilots) behind typed contracts, evals and cost budgets.

- Expose systems to agents through MCP servers with auth, audit and data redaction.

- Run what you ship: CI/CD, containers, Azure/AWS, observability.

You Have

- 3–7 years shipping production web or mobile apps across front end, back end and database.

- Strong C/C++, C#/.NET or Python on the backend; strong TypeScript, React and CSS on the front.

- Daily use of coding agents on real work, and the habit of catching their mistakes.

- At least one LLM-powered feature live in production.

- Git, automated testing, CI/CD and clear written English.

Bonus Points

- MCP servers, agent workflows or eval harnesses you built.

- GStreamer or ApraPipes, CUDA, NVIDIA Jetson or DGX Spark, or video streaming (WebRTC, HLS).

- Work with sensitive or regulated data (PII redaction, de-identification, access control).

- Open-source contributions.

Why Join

- Frontier models and coding agents paid for, plus NVIDIA Jetson and DGX Spark hardware to build on.

- Work that matters: our own products and customer programs with real-world impact.

- Small teams, direct access to the founders, and mentors with decades of systems experience.

How We Hire

AI is allowed at every stage: a 4-hour take-home built with your agents, a live session extending it, a review of an agent-written pull request with seeded bugs, and a conversation with the founders.

**Qualifications**
**Experience:**

* Min 8 years of relevant experience in full stack development and Data Science (ML and DL) combined.

Must have substantial experience in:
  
  

* 8+ years, building production web applications and services with Python and Node.js.
* Front‑end development with React/Angular/Vue; strong TypeScript/JavaScript fundamentals.
* API design and development with REST and GraphQL; experience with microservices patterns.

* Networking basics: DNS, load balancers, firewalls, routing, ports, and protocols.
* Observability: application monitoring, centralized logging, tracing; strong debugging and problem‑resolution skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise identity and access management, secrets vaults, and compliance controls.
* Knowledge of data privacy and responsible AI practices; experience implementing audit and guardrail tooling.

title: Software Engineer II, Full Stack (Frontend Focused) (Bangalore, India)
description:
**About AiPrise**
AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring, enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We're hiring a frontend-focused Full Stack Software Engineer II: strong on the frontend and comfortable across the stack.
  
  
This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You'll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate. Most of your work will be on what our customers and their users see: the onboarding flow end users go through, our Web, Flutter and React Native SDKs, and the case management product compliance teams use every day. You'll also build the APIs and backend changes these features need.
  
  
You'll work closely with founders, product and design, turning messy real world compliance problems into simple, reliable products.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Build & Own Features End-to-End
  
  

* Design, build, and ship product features across the stack, with a focus on the frontend
* Own features from requirements → implementation → deployment → monitoring
* Build onboarding flows for KYC and KYB, including forms, document upload, ID capture, selfie and liveness
* Make these flows work well on all kinds of phones and browsers, and inside customer apps through our SDKs
* Build the backend APIs and data changes your features need

Drive Technical Excellence
  
  

* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code
* Keep the product fast and stable, including on low-end devices and slow networks
* Debug production issues with urgency; own them until they're fixed
* Participate in code reviews and help improve how we build and release

Collaborate
  
  

* Work cross-functionally with product, design, compliance and customer success teams
* Think about the full user journey, and suggest better ways to solve a problem, not just build what is asked
* Contribute to technical decision-making and help shape engineering culture as the team scales

What We're Looking For
  
  
**Must-Have**

* 2-4 years of professional experience building and shipping production software
* Strong TypeScript and React , including performance and state management
* Good HTML and CSS , with responsive, mobile-first layouts
* Experience building REST APIs in a backend language like Python or Node.js, and working with relational databases
* Proven ability to own features end-to-end , from ambiguous requirements to production
* Good product and UX sense
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills; comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases
* Clear communication

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with mobile web, camera or media APIs , and cross-browser issues
* Flutter or React Native experience, or experience building SDKs and libraries
* Experience with web performance and frontend testing tools
* Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments or identity verification
* Hands-on experience with AWS, CI/CD and Docker

Success in This Role Looks Like
  
  

* In 3 Months : You've shipped 2-3 significant features to production and own a key area of the product, e.g. ID capture, one of our SDKs, or a part of case management
* In 9 Months : You're the go-to person for a critical part of the product, drive technical decisions for it, and have clearly improved something users feel, like onboarding completion rate or speed

**Why AiPrise**

* Build mission-critical software that directly fights financial crime and fraud for companies like Meta and leading fintechs
* Work with users and data from 200+ countries
* Join a fast-moving YC-backed startup where your work has immediate customer impact
* Ship quickly. Your code will reach production in days, not months
* Collaborate in-person with a talented, mission-driven team in Bengaluru
* Competitive compensation

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Enterprise Bot**

Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.

Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.

**Your first months at Enterprise Bot**

We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys working across both frontend and backend and wants to build products at the intersection of software engineering and AI.

You’ll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.

This isn't a role where you'll just pick up tickets and write code.

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end — understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.

****What You'll Do****

****Full Stack Development****

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.
* Build responsive, intuitive, and high-performance user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js.
* Work across the complete product lifecycle — from technical design to development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
* Build reusable components and maintain clean, scalable code.

****Backend & APIs****

* Design and develop secure and reusable RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
* Build backend services using Node.js, Express.js, Koa, or similar frameworks.
* Design efficient database schemas and optimise queries.
* Work with MongoDB and SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Implement authentication and authorisation using technologies such as JWT and OAuth.
* Build integrations with internal and external systems.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve system performance and reliability.

****Frontend****

* Build modern web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
* Translate product and UI designs into high-quality, production-ready interfaces.
* Create reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture.
* Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant.
* Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.

****AI & Agentic Systems****

You’ll be working in an AI-first engineering environment.

* Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications.
* Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation.
* Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration.
* Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations.
* Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences.
* Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools.

You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI.

****Quality, Performance & Reliability****

* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai.
* Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Document technical solutions, APIs, and architecture where required.

****Collaboration****

* Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers.
* Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions.
* Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Take ownership of features and deliver them from
  **concept → production**
  .
* Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture.

**What we are looking for**

* 2–4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
* Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js.
* Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs.
* Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
* Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently.
* Good understanding of responsive web development.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.

****Good to Have****

* Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
* Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
* Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures.
* Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
* Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company.
* Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows.

****What We Value****

At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles.

We're looking for someone who:

* Doesn't wait for instructions for every step.
* Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment.
* Cares about the quality of what they build.
* Is curious about AI and new technologies.
* Enjoys learning and experimenting.
* Can balance speed with good engineering practices.
* Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack.

**Benefits**

* Build products at the forefront of GenAI and Conversational AI.
* Work on real-world AI products used by international enterprises.
* Get exposure to LLMs, AI agents, automation, voice, and real-time systems.
* Work with a global engineering and product team.
* High ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact.
* Flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative culture.
* Opportunity to learn and work with rapidly evolving AI technologies.
* Competitive compensation and strong opportunities for growth.

**Join our team**

If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
*We offer a flexible working policy that supports a healthy balance between personal and professional well-being. This role requires in-office presence on Tuesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, connect, and learn from peers - while also maintaining the flexibility for meaningful work-life balance.*
**Being a Staff Full Stack Engineer at iManage means**
You are a passionate Full Stack engineer, first and foremost — someone with strong engineering fundamentals who is deeply productive in — or ready to go deep on — TypeScript, Node.js, and React. You take end-to-end ownership of features: from intuitive user interfaces to scalable backend services. You write reusable, robust, and maintainable code and embrace Test-Driven Development to deliver high-quality, cloud-ready software.
  
  
You are fluent in AI-native, agentic software development — pairing with coding agents like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc., as force multipliers, practicing spec-driven development, and applying the same rigor to agent-generated code as to any human PR. You are curious about emerging technology trends, especially agentic workflows, generative AI, and modern automation frameworks, and you bring that curiosity into the solutions you design.
  
  
**iM Responsible For**

* Designing and building highly scalable, performant full-stack applications using Node.js and TypeScript, ready for cloud deployment.
* Accelerating delivery through agentic development practices — decomposing features into well-scoped, agent-executable tasks, providing agents the right context, and rigorously reviewing and validating their output before merge.
* Writing resilient, maintainable backend services backed by relational databases.
* Implementing high-traffic web applications from designs provided by the UX team, using ReactJS and NextJS.
* Developing and maintaining comprehensive test suites using Jest and Playwright.
* Participating in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Owning a product module and driving it through the full development lifecycle, collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams, product managers, and UX designers.
* Staying current with industry trends — particularly automation, AI, and workflow orchestration — and influencing improvements to the technology stack.

**iM Qualified Because I Have**

* 8+ years of experience building high-performance, resilient backend services in any modern language (e.g., TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java, Python, C#) — with the aptitude and willingness to work primarily in TypeScript.
* A track record of learning new languages, frameworks, and paradigms quickly — we value engineering excellence over any specific stack.
* Strong frontend development skills with React or a comparable modern framework; production experience with ReactJS/NextJS and TypeScript is a plus.
* Proficiency with relational databases and data modeling.
* Strong understanding of OAuth2/OIDC authentication flows.
* Excellent understanding of object-oriented programming and design principles.
* Practical experience with modern build and tooling ecosystems (Git, plus bundlers/package managers such as Webpack, Vite, or NPM/pnpm).
* Hands-on experience in automated testing — unit, integration, and end-to-end (Jest and Playwright, or equivalents like Vitest or Cypress).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Argo CD.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Knowledge of the message broker pattern, using at least one message queuing service.

**iM Getting To**

* Take on meaningful, high-impact challenges by leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best-in-class protocols to drive innovation.
* Own my career path with our internal development framework. Ask us more about this!
* Expand my skill set and earn certifications with unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning courses and interactive Microsoft courses & training.
* Be part of a supportive and experienced team within a dynamic, inclusive, and encouraging culture.
* Enjoy flexible work hours that empower me to balance personal time with professional commitments.
* Collaborate in a modern, open-plan workspace featuring a gaming area, free snacks and drinks, and regular social events.

**iManage Is Supporting Me By**

* Creating an inclusive environment where you’re encouraged to help shape the culture by bringing your unique perspective, not just by fitting in.
* Providing a market leading salary determined through a fair and consistent process, equitable for all our employees, and regularly reviewed against industry benchmarks.
* Rewarding me with an annual performance-based bonus.
* Providing enhanced parental leave (20 weeks for primary and 10 weeks for secondary caregiver at 100% pay)
* Offering comprehensive Health/Accidental /Life Insurance.
* Encouraging me to make use of our top-tier flexible time off policy, which includes 21 paid leaves, 9 casual and sick, close to 10-12 Indian Holidays, and for other life events.
* Having multiple company wellness days each year to prioritize mental health and well-being.
* Providing access to RethinkCare, a global behavioral health platform that enhances personal well-being, strengthens professional resilience, and empowers parental success through expert-led training and resources.

**About iManage**
At iManage, we are dedicated to Making Knowledge Work™. Our intelligent, cloud-enabled, and secure platform is trusted by 4,100+ customers and 430,000 users worldwide, managing over 11 billion documents and 11 petabytes of data. We empower professionals across 65+ countries to unlock the full potential of their business content and communications. In this position, the engineer supports critical business operations and decision making through creation domain data exploration, data processing pipeline, and business intelligence reports.
  
  
This is primarily a non-travel job. Business travel will be necessary on special requirements and will be for a short duration. Depending on the need, there will be an International Short-Term assignment for 6 months in the first year for training & development.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain full-stack manufacturing intelligence applications using modern frontend, backend, and database technologies
* Build intuitive React/TypeScript user experiences for manufacturing dashboards, workflow tools, operational insights, and engineering applications
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI or comparable frameworks, with clear service boundaries, resilient error handling, and efficient request processing
* Integrate applications with manufacturing and enterprise systems, including MES, SCADA, PLC/controls data, historians, equipment interfaces, and event-driven data services
* Design and optimize PostgreSQL data models, queries, and data pipelines for production, quality, equipment, and process information
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, auditability, and data-access controls for applications used across GM manufacturing and engineering environments
* Deploy and operate applications across enterprise, cloud, and edge environments using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, and production monitoring
* Create automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and establish engineering practices that improve application reliability, maintainability, and release quality
* Translate manufacturing and engineering problems into clear technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable product outcomes
* Collaborate with controls, manufacturing, quality, data science, cybersecurity, and IT teams to deliver solutions that improve visibility, productivity, quality, and decision-making
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement performance and reliability improvements across the application stack
* Document architecture, APIs, deployment procedures, operating standards, and support processes while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Ability to work effectively in both central engineering and plant environments, including time on the plant floor around operating equipment
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production full-stack applications
* 3+ years of experience delivering manufacturing intelligence, industrial software, or data-intensive enterprise applications across frontend, backend, and data layers
* Advanced TypeScript/JavaScript skills with React, including component architecture, state management, data visualization, responsive and accessible user interfaces, and frontend testing
* Strong Python development skills with FastAPI or comparable frameworks, including asynchronous programming, REST/OpenAPI service design, request validation, dependency management, and automated testing
* Advanced SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including relational data modeling, schema design, migrations, indexing, query and transaction performance, and data-quality controls
* Experience delivering manufacturing intelligence, industrial software, or data-intensive enterprise applications that connect operational data to business and engineering workflows
* Experience designing data pipelines and event-driven architectures for equipment telemetry, time-series data, production data, quality data, and manufacturing workflows
* Hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD automation, environment configuration, and deployment practices for production applications
* Demonstrated intermediate-level proficiency with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based application development.
* Experience implementing automated unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing, as well as observability using structured logging, metrics, tracing, health checks, and alerting
* Working knowledge of application and platform security, including OAuth/OIDC, role-based access control, secrets management, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and least-privilege design
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot distributed systems, diagnose performance and reliability issues, and translate manufacturing requirements into maintainable technical designs and production releases
* Basic understanding of Databricks and its integration with other systems
* Working understanding of automotive manufacturing processes
* Working knowledge of applying AI/ML techniques to manufacturing data, including integrating AI services and models into production applications, evaluating model outputs, using prompt engineering or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and monitoring AI system performance

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Intermediate-to-expert proficiency with Databricks, including Spark and SQL data pipelines, Delta Lake, workflow orchestration, data-quality controls, and integration with manufacturing and enterprise systems
* Experience integrating OT and IT systems such as MES, SCADA, PLC/controls systems, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, historians, and event or message-based platforms
* Experience working with manufacturing data models, time-series data, equipment telemetry, production genealogy, quality data, or process data
* Experience building data visualization and analytical user experiences for operational, engineering, quality, or maintenance users
* Experience with cloud-native and edge architectures, including Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, distributed systems, and disconnected or intermittently connected environments

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Security
description:
**Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Security**

**﻿GlobalGuard Bengaluru, India**

**Role Type:**
Highly experienced, hands-on Full Stack / Backend-focused Engineer

**About GlobalGuard**

GlobalGuard is a cybersecurity company focused on protecting critical communications, data and cloud environments against evolving threats. Building on its experience delivering commercial security products, GlobalGuard is expanding into AI security and governance to help organisations adopt AI safely and responsibly.

**Role Overview**

GlobalGuard is building an emerging AI security and governance platform for organisations adopting modern AI technologies.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build the central platform and user experience through which organisations manage, monitor and operate these security capabilities. This is not a front-end-only role. You will design backend services, APIs, data models and enterprise workflows as well as deliver high-quality user experiences.

As an early engineer on the product, you will work closely with the Principal Engineer, taking significant ownership of the platform from data and service design through to the customer-facing application.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement secure, scalable backend services and APIs.
* Build the central management platform for an enterprise AI-security product.
* Design data models for organisations, users, assets, policies, events and security configuration.
* Build authentication, authorisation and enterprise identity capabilities.
* Develop administration, policy-management and configuration workflows.
* Build systems for ingesting, processing, storing and presenting security telemetry.
* Develop investigation, audit, approval and operational workflows.
* Build intuitive interfaces that allow security and IT teams to understand complex information quickly.
* Design and implement dashboards, asset views, search, filtering and reporting capabilities.
* Build secure integrations with enterprise systems and external security platforms.
* Design multi-tenant services with strong isolation and security boundaries.
* Contribute to event-processing, notification and integration architectures.
* Participate in architecture, threat modelling, automated testing, troubleshooting and production operation.
* Continuously improve performance, usability, reliability and maintainability.

**Core Technical Focus**

* Secure SaaS and enterprise application development.
* Backend services, APIs, integrations and high-volume data-processing systems.
* Modern web application development.
* Multi-tenant data architecture.
* Authentication, identity and role-based access control.
* Security telemetry, event processing and auditability.
* Enterprise administration and workflow design.
* Cloud-native application architecture.
* Observability, automation and production operations.
* Applied AI and AI-security concepts.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Quickly understand the product direction and translate it into a practical application architecture.
* Establish secure and maintainable foundations for the central platform.
* Deliver backend services and APIs that support rapidly evolving product capabilities.
* Build a polished management experience suitable for enterprise security teams.
* Provide clear visibility into platform activity, security events and operational state.
* Establish strong patterns for authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation and auditability.
* Build effective development, testing, deployment and operational practices.
* Take ownership of features from data model and API through to production user experience.
* Become the primary technical owner of the product's central application and management experience.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Extensive commercial software engineering experience building and operating production systems.
* Strong backend development experience and a solid understanding of distributed application architecture.
* Strong experience with modern web development frameworks and TypeScript/JavaScript ecosystems.
* Experience designing production APIs and service interfaces.
* Strong relational database and data-modelling experience.
* Experience building multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation and enterprise identity patterns.
* Experience building event-driven or asynchronous processing systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, containers and modern deployment environments.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability and production operations.
* Strong understanding of secure web and API development.
* Ability to design usable interfaces for complex technical or security workflows.
* Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technologies and turn requirements into well-designed production software.
* Practical understanding of modern AI applications and agentic architectures.

**Highly Desirable Experience**

* Commercial cybersecurity products or security platforms.
* Security operations, telemetry or investigation products.
* Identity and access-management platforms.
* Enterprise administration and policy-management systems.
* Cloud security or infrastructure-management products.
* Large-scale event, analytics or observability platforms.
* Enterprise integration and workflow systems.
* Data-protection or governance products.
* AI security, AI governance or agentic applications.

**The Type of Person Who Will Succeed**

You should enjoy owning a broad technical problem rather than working only within a narrowly defined front-end or backend function. You will be comfortable moving between architecture, data modelling, APIs, security, user experience and production operations.

The product is evolving quickly, so you should be able to take incomplete requirements, understand the underlying customer problem, propose a sensible design and deliver a robust solution without waiting for every detail to be specified.

You will take responsibility for the quality of the finished product, not simply the completion of individual tickets.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer (Full Stack) – Avni Platform**
**Build an open-source platform that powers frontline programmes across healthcare, education, livelihoods, water management and more.**

**Location:**

Bengaluru (Work from Office)

**Experience:**

3–8 years (Exceptional candidates are encouraged to apply)

**Compensation:**

₹14–25 LPA (based on capability and role fit)

**Build one platform. Solve problems across many sectors.**

At Samanvay, we believe technology should make frontline work simpler, smarter and more effective.

Our flagship product, Avni, is an open-source, offline-first platform that enables nonprofits, governments and social enterprises to digitise field programmes and make better decisions using data.

Imagine building a platform where the same feature could help a community health worker identify high-risk pregnancies, a teacher monitor student learning, a field engineer inspect water infrastructure, or a nonprofit support livelihood programmes—all without changing the underlying product. That’s Avni.

Unlike most enterprise software, Avni is designed for environments where internet connectivity is unreliable, workflows are constantly evolving, and users have varying levels of digital familiarity.

Some of the people who use Avni every day are experienced clinicians. Others are community volunteers or frontline workers who are using a smartphone for the first time as part of their work. Designing software that works beautifully for all of them is one of our biggest engineering challenges—and one of the reasons our work is so rewarding.

We don’t build custom applications for every programme. We build one configurable platform that powers healthcare, education, nutrition, livelihoods, water management, climate resilience and community development. Every capability you build has the potential to unlock entirely new use cases.

If you enjoy building products with real technical depth and real-world impact, we’d love to meet you.

Learn more:
https://samanvayfoundation.org

**About the Role**

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy building products—not just implementing features.

As part of the Platform Engineering team, you’ll help shape the future of Avni. You’ll work across backend, frontend, mobile and cloud infrastructure, solving problems ranging from offline data synchronisation and configurable workflows to deployment automation, AI-powered capabilities and production reliability.

This is a role with significant ownership. You’ll think beyond individual features and contribute to the long-term evolution of the platform while collaborating closely with product managers, implementation teams and customers.

**What You’ll Own**

**Product Engineering**

* Design and develop new capabilities for the Avni platform.
* Build scalable, maintainable and well-tested software.
* Improve platform performance, reliability and user experience.
* Participate in technical design discussions and architecture decisions.
* Contribute to Avni’s open-source ecosystem.

**Platform Engineering**

* Improve deployment automation and developer productivity.
* Enhance CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
* Improve observability, monitoring and operational reliability.
* Build internal tooling that improves engineering efficiency.

**Solving Real-World Problems**

* Design reusable platform capabilities based on real-world programme needs.
* Work with implementation teams to solve technically challenging customer requirements.
* Investigate complex production issues and improve the platform to prevent similar issues in the future.

**Continuous Learning**

* Explore emerging technologies and AI capabilities that can improve the platform.
* Share knowledge through code reviews, design discussions and mentoring.

**Technology Stack**

**Backend**

* Java
* Spring Boot
* NodeJS
* PostgreSQL
* REST APIs

**Frontend & Mobile**

* React
* React Native
* JavaScript

**Infrastructure**

* Linux
* AWS
* Docker
* Cloudflare
* Git
* CI/CD

**What You’ll Bring**

**Must Have**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Good knowledge of Java or Node.js.
* Experience building REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases.
* Ability to independently design, build and debug production software.
* Passion for writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

**Nice to Have**

* React or React Native.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with Docker and CI/CD.
* Android development experience.
* Contributions to open-source projects.

**What Makes Someone Successful Here**

We’re less interested in the number of years you’ve worked and more interested in how you approach engineering.

**You’ll thrive if you:**

* Take ownership from design to production.
* Enjoy solving ambiguous engineering problems.
* Think in terms of products and platforms rather than tickets.
* Balance engineering quality with pragmatic delivery.
* Learn quickly and enjoy exploring new technologies.
* Collaborate well with people across disciplines.
* Care about building software that makes a meaningful difference.

**Why Join Samanvay?**
**Build one platform. Solve many problems.**

Unlike most software companies that build for a single business domain, Avni supports healthcare, education, nutrition, livelihoods, water management, climate resilience and community development. Every capability you build can enable entirely new kinds of programmes without changing the core platform.

**Solve genuinely interesting engineering problems.**

Offline-first applications, configurable workflows, low-code platform development, mobile synchronisation, cloud infrastructure, AI-powered features and large-scale deployments present technical challenges rarely found together in a single product.

**Build an open-source digital public good.**

Your work won’t disappear behind proprietary walls. You’ll contribute to an open-source platform that organisations can adopt, improve and build upon to create greater social impact.

**Own meaningful work.**

You’ll influence technical decisions, product direction and platform architecture—not just implement specifications.

**Meet your users.**

We encourage our engineers to spend time in the field with our partner organisations. Whether it’s accompanying a community health worker on home visits, observing a teacher using Avni in a classroom, or understanding how field teams work in remote locations, we believe the best products are built by engineers who understand their users firsthand.

**Grow with a small, high-impact team.**

You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers and implementation specialists in a collaborative environment where your ideas can shape the future of the platform.

**Engineering at Samanvay**

We believe great software is built by engineers who care deeply about users, code quality and continuous learning.

Our engineering culture values:

* Simplicity over unnecessary complexity.
* Clean, maintainable and well-tested code.
* Thoughtful design discussions and constructive code reviews.
* Ownership from idea to production.
* Learning through experimentation and collaboration.
* Technology choices driven by long-term maintainability.

We’re looking for engineers who enjoy building products that last—not just shipping features.

**Experience & Qualification**

* 3–8 years of professional software engineering experience.
* B.E., B.Tech., M.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Apply**

If this sounds like the kind of engineering challenge you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Full stack AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job What you’ll actually do Build real things. You’ll write production code across the full stack — React frontends, Python/Node backends, ClickHouse queries, Kafka event pipelines, LangGraph agent workflows, and YAML\-driven process definitions. Not prototypes. Not demos. Stuff that runs in production for real companies moving real cargo across real oceans. Talk to enterprise clients. You’ll sit across from logistics managers, freight forwarders, and operations leads. You’ll listen to their messy, exception\-filled processes — 6 approval levels, 4 document types, 3 systems that don’t talk to each other — and turn that chaos into structured workflows they can actually use. This isn’t optional. It’s the job. Think AI\-first. Every problem you encounter, your first question should be: “Can an agent handle this?” Not “let me build a CRUD app.” You’ll design agents that extract fields from Bills of Lading, validate invoices against purchase orders, auto\-route approvals based on business rules, and flag exceptions before humans even notice them. You’ll work with LLMs, RAG pipelines, document parsers, and agent orchestration frameworks daily. Own problems end\-to\-end. You won’t hand off a spec and wait. You’ll identify the problem, design the solution, build it, configure it for the client, deploy it, watch it in production, and fix what breaks. The FDE model means you own outcomes, not tasks. The tech you’ll work with Frontend: React, React Flow (node\-based graph editors) Backend: Python, Node.js, FastAPI Data: ClickHouse, Kafka (event streaming), Debezium (CDC) AI/ML: LangGraph (agent orchestration), LLMs (prompt engineering, RAG, tool use), DPT\-2 (document extraction), PageIndex (long\-document reasoning), Weaviate (vector search) Permissions: OpenFGA (Zanzibar\-based relationship access control) Observability: Langfuse (LLM tracing), OpenTelemetry Cost control: LiteLLM (gateway \+ budgets), Orkestra (model routing) Infrastructure: dbt (semantic layer / MetricFlow), Temporal (scheduling), DataHub / OpenMetadata (catalog) You don’t need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up any of it in a week. What we’re looking for The non\-negotiables You can code. Full\-stack, independently, at production quality. You’ve built things — not just assignments, but projects, tools, systems that other people actually used. You’re comfortable across the stack and you don’t need hand\-holding to ship a feature. You can communicate. You can explain a technical architecture to a non\-technical client. You can run a discovery call. You can write a clear document. You can present without slides being your crutch. This is not a “nice to have.” Half the job is translating between the worlds of technology and business. You can think. When someone describes a messy process, you don’t just nod — you ask why before how. You spot patterns underneath apparent chaos. You push back on unnecessary complexity. You can hold a system in your head and reason about what happens when things go wrong. You learn fast. You don’t need to know logistics. You need to be the kind of person who, after two client calls and a week of reading, can hold their own in a conversation about Bills of Lading, demurrage charges, and incoterm implications. Domain knowledge is teachable. Curiosity and raw learning speed are not. Strong signals You’ve built something with LLMs — not just used ChatGPT, but actually integrated an LLM into a working system. Prompt engineering, tool use, agents, RAG — any of it. You’ve worked on a side project or open\-source contribution that required you to understand a domain outside of CS. You can take a vague, messy brief and turn it into a structured plan without needing everything spelled out. You default to shipping over perfecting. You’d rather build a rough working version in 2 hours than spend 2 days on a flawless spec. You’ve done consulting, client\-facing work, or been in a situation where you had to understand someone else’s world to solve their problem. What this role is NOT It’s not a pure backend/frontend engineering job where you write code in isolation. It’s not a PM role where you make decks and write tickets but never ship code. It’s not a consulting gig where you give advice but don’t build. It’s not a support role where you configure existing products without understanding the architecture. \* About GoComet GoComet is a supply chain visibility and automation platform used by enterprises across 30\+ countries. We track shipments across ocean, air, road, and rail. We manage procurement, contracts, invoices, and compliance. And now, with Nova, we’re building the AI\-native operating layer that ties it all together. Logistics moves $12 trillion in goods every year. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, email chains, and phone calls. We’re fixing that — not with another dashboard, but with intelligent, governed, agent\-driven automation.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \['Python Node.js Kafka React.js Clickhouse DBT Python', 'AIML', 'DL', 'SQL OpenFGA']
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 NA

title: Member of Technical Staff - Fullstack
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 Join the Pipeline Engineering team at Everpure™ as a Full Stack Software Engineer to build and scale the pipeline visibility layer for FlashArray, FlashBlade, and Hyperscale — the core platform through which engineers and customers understand and act on CI results. In this high\-impact position, you will own responsive web interfaces, API gateway architecture, and AI\-assisted workflows that convert raw pipeline data into actionable signal, eliminating operational toil across our engineering organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build the Pipeline Visibility Layer: Architect and ship high\-performance web applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks to deliver real\-time pipeline status, test results, and failure analytics at enterprise scale.
* Own Gateway \& Backend Services: Develop and operate low\-latency API gateways and backend microservices using typed systems languages (such as Go or Rust) to aggregate data across systems, enforce strict multi\-tenant boundaries, and maintain reliable system contracts.
* Deliver Secure Access Controls: Implement robust authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, RBAC) to ensure internal teams and external customers experience seamlessly scoped and fully audited access.
* Integrate AI Triage Workflows: Engineer retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM integrations over test metadata and failure logs to automate root\-cause summaries, flake classification, and developer triage.
* Drive Observability \& Systems Ownership: Instrument end\-to\-end frontend and backend telemetry to continuously improve time\-to\-insight, API latency, and UI performance while directly operating services in production.


**What You Bring**
* Frontend Architecture: Deep technical mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React.js or Vue.js), including state management, component architecture, and web performance optimization.
* Backend Systems \& API Design: Strong proficiency in a typed systems language (Go or Rust) alongside Python for service orchestration, paired with proven experience designing resilient REST or GraphQL APIs, concurrency patterns, and idempotent workflows.
* Identity \& Security Engineering: Solid expertise implementing secure, multi\-tenant authentication patterns (OIDC, OAuth2, SAML/SSO) and role\-based access control systems.
* AI \& Retrieval Systems: Applied experience designing prompt workflows, integrating vector databases, and implementing RAG patterns using LLM APIs to surface contextual data.
* Infrastructure \& Data Foundations: Practical experience containerizing production workloads with Kubernetes, debugging complex Linux environments, and querying distributed data stores to drive performance outcomes.


**Location Requirements:** 
 We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Staff Engineer – Observability Platform
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

****The Opportunity****
 We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Observability team. This role is ideal for a highly technical engineer who thrives on uncovering the truth behind complex system behaviors, diagnosing difficult production challenges, and driving platform\-wide improvements.
   

  

 As a Staff Engineer, you will operate as a force multiplier across engineering teams, helping Postman build world\-class observability capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and developer productivity. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Platform, Product, Security, and Data teams to identify systemic issues, establish operational excellence, and ensure engineering teams have the visibility they need to operate at scale.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Drive the technical vision and architecture for Postman's observability platform.
* Design and build scalable solutions for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and operational analytics.
* Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and drive long\-term corrective actions.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve service reliability, availability, performance, and operational maturity.
* Establish observability standards, best practices, and instrumentation frameworks across the company.
* Build tooling and automation that enable faster incident detection, diagnosis, and resolution.
* Leverage telemetry data to uncover performance bottlenecks, capacity risks, and reliability gaps.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives focused on platform health, operational excellence, and engineering productivity.
* Mentor senior engineers and help raise the technical bar across the organization.


****What We're Looking For****
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with significant exposure to distributed systems and cloud\-native architectures.
* Strong expertise in observability domains including monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, telemetry pipelines, and incident management.
* Experience operating large\-scale production systems with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Deep understanding of system debugging, root\-cause analysis, performance optimization, and production operations.
* Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, Node.js, or similar.
* Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Honeycomb, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority.
* Strong communication skills and a data\-driven approach to problem\-solving.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience building internal developer platforms or observability platforms at scale.
* Exposure to AIOps, intelligent alerting, anomaly detection, or AI\-powered operational tooling.
* Experience driving reliability initiatives across multiple engineering organizations.
* Background in SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Developer Productivity.


****Why This Role Matters****
 The Observability team sits at the center of Postman's engineering ecosystem. Success in this role means creating the visibility, insights, and operational intelligence that enable every engineering team at Postman to build and operate reliable products with confidence.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact Staff Engineer position for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, driving engineering excellence, and uncovering the signals that help teams make better decisions.
   

  

**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.
